<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 12"
    pfs="Restricted"
>
[Arboreal Staff](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2392)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="No Alignment" url="/Rules.aspx?ID=95" />
<trait label="Intelligent" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=280" />
<trait label="Primal" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=134" />
<trait label="Staff" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=151" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 193

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Perception** +25; [precise](/Rules.aspx?ID=411) vision (low-light) 60 feet, [imprecise](/Rules.aspx?ID=412) hearing 30 feet, imprecise [tremorsense](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=40) 30 feet (only when touching the ground)

**Communication** speech ([Arboreal](/Languages.aspx?ID=26), [Common](/Languages.aspx?ID=1), [Fey](/Languages.aspx?ID=119); [_speak with plants_](/Spells.aspx?ID=294))

**Skills** [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) +22, [Forest Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) +25, [Nature](/Skills.aspx?ID=10) +25

**Int** +4, **Wis** +6, **Cha** +4

**Will** +27 

</column>

---        

Rather than passing on when they feel their death approaching, a rare few elderly [arboreals](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=8) undergo a ritual of preservation. This rite fuses the arboreal's consciousness into a branch, allowing their spirit to live on within the object. The branch functions as a [_greater verdant staff_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=364), though the arboreal spirit allows only partners willing to safeguard nature to use the staff's spells. An arboreal who decides to become an _arboreal staff_ is more connected to shorter-lived species than others of their kind. Most choose to endure to share their knowledge with future generations, but they take a long view in ways that can be frustrating to their wielders.

 In addition to the activation and spells of a _greater verdant staff_, an _arboreal staff_ can cast the spells it holds as if it were the staff's wielder, though it usually does so only to benefit a partner. The staff also has [_earthbind_](/Spells.aspx?ID=94) available as a 3rd-rank spell.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Wardens of Wildwood</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Healing" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=89" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Vitality" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=509" />
<trait label="Wand" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=164" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #201: Pactbreaker](/Sources.aspx?ID=241) pg. 81

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This gnarled wand is made from the branch of an [arboreal](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=364). 

**Activate** <actions string="" /> Cast a Spell;  **Frequency** once per day, plus overcharge;   **Effect** You cast [_heal_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1554) at the indicated rank. After you cast the spell, the raw primal energy stored within the arboreal from which the wand was made washes over one target you choose and tries to purify its essence. The wand attempts to [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=2250) the lowest level [affliction](/Rules.aspx?ID=2389) affecting your target. It uses your casting modifier and a counteract rank of half the wand’s item level rounded up.

**Craft Requirements** Supply a casting of _heal_ of the appropriate level and a branch freely given by an arboreal.

<title
    level="1"

>
[Arboreal's Revenge](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1174)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Cursed" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=274" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Guns & Gears (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=98) pg. 160

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 2 hands

**Bulk** 2
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Weapon** [Blunderbuss](/Weapons.aspx?ID=196)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This walnut and brass _+1 [striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=280) [blunderbuss](/Weapons.aspx?ID=196)_ has a natural look, with wood worn smooth by time, but left knotted and gnarled. The handgrip beneath the flared muzzle is a well-positioned bulging tree knot, and the long stock looks as if it was grown to fit you. On closer examination, the whorls and rings in the wood resemble eyes.

 _Arboreal's revenge_ is a haunted firearm constructed with wood hewn from a living [arboreal](/MonsterFamilies.aspx?ID=8), slaying the arboreal and trapping its spirit in the firearm. Perhaps a patient wielder could one day put the arboreal's spirit to rest, or at least come to terms with it, abating the drawbacks of the weapon while keeping its advantages.

 When you first fire _arboreal's revenge_, the blunderbuss fuses with you, after which it's almost impossible to remove it from your possession with a [_remove curse_](/Spells.aspx?ID=250) or similar effect, like many cursed items. You gain weakness 5 to [fire](/Traits.aspx?ID=72) and the flat check for you to recover from [persistent fire damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29) increases from 15 to 17, or from 10 to 12 if you receive appropriate help. 

Whenever you wield _arboreal's revenge_, the arboreal spirit bound to the blunderbuss attempts to overtake you. The wood handgrip sprouts roots which grow around your hand, binding both of your hands to the firearm. You gain a +4 circumstance bonus to your Reflex DC when defending against checks to [Disarm](/Actions.aspx?ID=41) you. However, you can't Release your grip on the blunderbuss until you forcibly tear off the roots, though they do allow you to move your hands enough (and only enough) to reload and fire the blunderbuss. Tearing off the roots takes 1 minute.

 The arboreal haunting the firearm can use the following two effects whenever it wants, often using them at random. You can coax it into performing them each intentionally once per day, with the following activations.

**Activate** <actions string="Free Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The arboreal haunting the blunderbuss attempts to regrow itself into a new physical body by sprouting from the bodies of all the creatures that the firearm recently harmed. You and all creatures within 60 feet damaged by arboreal's revenge within the last minute must attempt a DC 20 Fortitude saving throw. On a failure, they take a –10-foot circumstance penalty to their Speeds as roots rapidly sprout from their wounds, which lasts until they [Escape](/Actions.aspx?ID=79) (DC 20).

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You cast [_barkskin_](/Spells.aspx?ID=20) from the blunderbuss as a 2nd-level primal spell. However, the weakness to fire imposed by barkskin is cumulative with the weakness to fire imposed by this weapon's curse, for a total of weakness 8 to fire.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

**Access** A character who is a member of the Pathfinder Society has access to this option.

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

The four different types of _scroll cases of simplicity_ often bear adornments appropriate to their magical tradition, such as angelic wings or otherworldly lettering. On the inside, intricate runic diagrams spiral out to surround the scroll stored within. A scroll placed within the case can be converted into energy to cast consistently useful spells depending on its type. You must be able to cast spells of a given tradition to use a _scroll case of simplicity_ of a corresponding type.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> Interact;    **Requirements** The scroll case contains a single scroll of a 1st-level spell; **Effect** You transfer the scroll’s energy into the scroll case, consuming the scroll, and you can immediately begin casting one of the scroll case’s spells. If you use any action other than to Cast a Spell from the scroll case after activating the _scroll case of simplicity_, the scroll and its energy are lost.

This compact compass repurposes ancient technology to draw fantastic powers from the mysterious magical items called [_aeon stones_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=407). It serves as a badge of office for agents of the Pathfinder Society and as a status symbol among adventurers of any stripe.

<title
level="2"

pfs="Standard"
>
Wayfinder
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Evocation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=65" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 617

_[**PFS Note**](/pathfinder-society) All Pathfinders have access._

**Price** 28 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

</column>

---

This compact compass repurposes ancient technology to draw fantastic powers from the mysterious magical items called [_aeon stones_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=407). It serves as a badge of office for agents of the Pathfinder Society and as a status symbol among adventurers of any stripe. A _wayfinder_ functions as a compass.

 An indentation in the middle of the _wayfinder_ can hold a single _aeon stone_. Placing an _aeon stone_ in this indentation provides you all the benefits of having the _aeon stone_ orbiting your head, but it protects the stone from being noticed or stolen as easily. You invest a _wayfinder_ and the _aeon stone_ within it simultaneously, and they count as only one item toward your investiture limit. An invested _aeon stone_ slotted in a _wayfinder_ also grants its resonant power.

 If you have more than one _wayfinder_ with an invested _aeon stone_ on your person at a given time, destructive interference from their resonance prevents you from gaining benefits from any of them. You can still benefit from additional _aeon stones_ orbiting your head, just not in _wayfinders_.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> command;     **Effect** The _wayfinder_ is targeted by a 1st-level [_light_](/Spells.aspx?ID=171) spell.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 2"
pfs="Standard"
>
Archaic Wayfinder
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Evocation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=65" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [World Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=6) pg. 17

_[**PFS Note**](/pathfinder-society) All characters have access to the archaic wayfinder_

**Price** 30 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

</row>

<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="" /><row>Cast a Spell</row></row>

</column>

---

An _archaic wayfinder_ functions as a compass and acts as a repository for one cantrip cast into it. To fill an _archaic wayfinder_, a spellcaster casts the chosen cantrip into the empty device, providing any necessary cost; the spell cannot be one that is normally cast as a free action or reaction. Activating an _archaic wayfinder_ is the same as the casting for the relevant spell. Once it has been activated, it becomes empty again. An _archaic wayfinder_ can hold an aeon stone and activate its resonant power. An _archaic wayfinder_ counts against the limit of one _wayfinder_ with a slotted resonant _[aeon stone](/Equipment.aspx?ID=407)_.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 4"
pfs="Limited"
>
Wayfinder of Rescue
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Evocation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=65" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [PFS Scenario #1-03: Escaping the Grave](/Sources.aspx?ID=9) pg. 42

**Price** 80 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

</column>

---

As a standard _wayfinder_, but once per day you can activate it to cast _[heal](/Spells.aspx?ID=148)_ on a creature other than yourself, using either the one-action or two-action version of _[heal](/Spells.aspx?ID=148)_ as a 1st-level spell.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 6"
pfs="Standard"
>
Bi-Resonant Wayfinder
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Evocation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=65" />
<trait label="Illusion" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=92" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Character Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=12) pg. 110

**Price** 200 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

**Access** A character who is a member of the Pathfinder Society has access to this option.

</column>

---

A _bi-resonant wayfinder_ is inlaid with intricate platinum wires in a complex array of conduits for magical energy. These conduits control the resonant interference of _aeon stones_. A _bi-resonant wayfinder_ works just like a regular _wayfinder_ except it has two _aeon stone_ slots, and the _aeon stones_ in both slots grant their resonant powers without interfering with each other. The _bi-resonant wayfinder_ and the two _aeon stones_ count as two items toward your investiture limit.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 4"
pfs="Standard"
>
Shining Wayfinder
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Abjuration" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=2" />
<trait label="Divination" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=47" />
<trait label="Evocation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=65" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Character Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=12) pg. 111

**Price** 100 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

**Access** A character who is a member of the Pathfinder Society has access to this option.

</column>

---

A _shining wayfinder_ is a polished silver compass blessed by the power of benevolent deities. It has the usual functions of a _wayfinder_, except instead of an activation to cast _light_, the shining wayfinder has the following two activations.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> command, Interact;     **Effect** You hold the _wayfinder_ and ask for guidance. The wayfinder casts [_guidance_](/Spells.aspx?ID=142) on you.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> command, Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You call upon the wayfinder’s divine blessings for yourself and your allies. The wayfinder casts [_bless_](/Spells.aspx?ID=25), with an emanation centered on itself. Once per turn, you can use a single action, which has the [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32) trait, to increase the emanation’s radius by 5 feet.

level="2"
right="Item 5"
pfs="Standard"
>

</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />

<trait label="Illusion" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=92" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

**Usage** worn

</column>

---

A _vanishing wayfinder_ is crafted of ivory chased with gold and silver. It has the usual functions of a _wayfinder_ and the following additional activation.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> command, Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You turn the _wayfinder_ in a circle while invoking its command word, gaining the effects of a 2nd-level [_invisibility_](/Spells.aspx?ID=164) spell for 5 minutes.

<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />

**Source** [PFS Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=50) pg. 30

_[**PFS Note**](/pathfinder-society) Players can gain access to faction-specific gear by taking the corresponding Faction Gear Access Game Reward, available when they reach 20 reputation with the respective faction._

**Price** 200 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

**Access** Member of the Pathfinder Society.

</column>

---

_Chronicler wayfinders_ bear a mystical connection to the _Pathfinder Chronicles_ themselves, granting them the ability to assist in situations where unusual lore is needed by drawing on lore from a particular topic. Each _chronicler wayfinder_ is attuned to a specific [Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) skill, chosen at the time of creation. In addition to the effects of a _wayfinder_, a chronicler wayfinder has the following activation.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> envision;     **Effect** You tap into the _Pathfinder Chronicles_ on the _chronicler wayfinder's_ attuned topic, gaining the effects of a [Recall Knowledge](/Actions.aspx?ID=26) action with the chosen Lore skill. For the Lore check's modifier, use whichever is better of +12 or your own modifier, using your level as your proficiency bonus even if you're untrained in the attuned Lore skill.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 10"
pfs="Limited"
>
Razmiri Wayfinder
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Illusion" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=92" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Necromancy" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=117" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [PFS Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=50) pg. 72

**Price** 900 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

</column>

---

Worn on a chain around the neck, a _Razmiri wayfinder_ functions as a [compass](/Equipment.aspx?ID=16) and provides its wearer a +1 item bonus to [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) checks to [Lie](/Actions.aspx?ID=47) or [Impersonate](/Actions.aspx?ID=46). _Razmiri wayfinders_ can also be used to grant temporary healing, making it easier for the wearer to impersonate a divine spellcaster.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> envision;  **Frequency** three times per day;   **Effect** You touch an adjacent creature, granting them 3d8 temporary Hit Points for 1 hour.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> manipulate;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You touch an adjacent creature and attempt a [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) check against one [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126) or [disease](/Traits.aspx?ID=46) afflicting the creature. On a success, you halt the effects of the poison or disease for 1 day, rather than removing it. This temporarily relieves any penalties imposed by the affliction but doesn't cure the effect or count against its duration; the poison or disease is merely halted for a time, and it resumes where it left off once this effect ends.

level="2"
right="Item 9"
pfs="Standard"
>
Elemental Wayfinder (Air)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Air" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=5" />
<trait label="Evocation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=65" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [PFS Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=50) pg. 122

_[**PFS Note**](/pathfinder-society) All characters affiliated with the Pathfinder Society have access to this item_

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

**Access** Member of the Pathfinder Society.

---

Pathfinder Society researchers recently created _elemental wayfinders_ with the assistance of the Society's elemental allies. In addition to the effects of a _wayfinder_, these _wayfinders_ each grant the ability to cast a particular elemental spell once per day, and can assist Pathfinders in exploring areas associated with their element. Additionally, you can cast [_feather fall_](/Spells.aspx?ID=111) as a primal innate spell once every 10 minutes.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> command;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The _wayfinder_ casts a 4th-level [_lightning bolt_](/Spells.aspx?ID=172).

level="2"

<trait label="Earth" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=55" />
<trait label="Evocation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=65" />

</traits>

Pathfinder Society researchers recently created _elemental wayfinders_ with the assistance of the Society's elemental allies. In addition to the effects of a _wayfinder_, these _wayfinders_ each grant the ability to cast a particular elemental spell once per day, and can assist Pathfinders in exploring areas associated with their element. Additionally, you dig twice as quickly as normal.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> command;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The _wayfinder_ casts a 4th-level [_stoneskin_](/Spells.aspx?ID=312).

level="2"
right="Item 9"

>

</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Evocation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=65" />
<trait label="Fire" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=72" />

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

**Access** Member of the Pathfinder Society.

</column>

---

Pathfinder Society researchers recently created _elemental wayfinders_ with the assistance of the Society's elemental allies. In addition to the effects of a _wayfinder_, these _wayfinders_ each grant the ability to cast a particular elemental spell once per day, and can assist Pathfinders in exploring areas associated with their element. Additionally, you gain resistance 5 to fire.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> command;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The _wayfinder_ casts a 4th-level [_fireball_](/Spells.aspx?ID=119).

<title
level="2"
right="Item 10"
pfs="Standard"
>
Elemental Wayfinder (Water)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Evocation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=65" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Water" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=165" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [PFS Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=50) pg. 122

_[**PFS Note**](/pathfinder-society) All characters affiliated with the Pathfinder Society have access to this item_

**Price** 900 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

**Access** Member of the Pathfinder Society.

Pathfinder Society researchers recently created _elemental wayfinders_ with the assistance of the Society's elemental allies. In addition to the effects of a _wayfinder_, these _wayfinders_ each grant the ability to cast a particular elemental spell once per day, and can assist Pathfinders in exploring areas associated with their element. Additionally, you gain the constant effects of [_water breathing_](/Spells.aspx?ID=370).

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> command;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The _wayfinder_ casts a 4th-level [_hydraulic torrent_](/Spells.aspx?ID=155).

<title
level="2"
right="Item 3"
pfs="Standard"
>
Fashionable Wayfinder
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Conjuration" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=33" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [PFS Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=50) pg. 122

_[**PFS Note**](/pathfinder-society) All characters affiliated with the Pathfinder Society have access to this item_

**Price** 50 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

**Access** Member of the Pathfinder Society.

_Fashionable wayfinders_ allow you to be dressed for success in almost any situation. In addition to the effects of a _wayfinder_, a _fashionable wayfinder_ can attune to up to three sets of mundane clothing in your possession during your daily preparations. A _fashionable wayfinder_ has the following activation.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> envision;     **Effect** You call one of the attuned sets of clothing onto yourself, changing clothes instantly and leaving you either holding the old set of clothing or with the old set folded neatly on the floor if you don't have a free hand to hold it. This activation can't change you into or out of a suit of armor of any kind. While the activation can transport the chosen attuned set of clothing onto you from up to 60 feet away, it can't transport any other creatures or items that might have been stored in the clothing.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 13"
pfs="Standard"
>
Homeward Wayfinder
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Conjuration" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=33" />
<trait label="Evocation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=65" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />

<row gap="medium">

_Homeward wayfinders_ are powerful escape tools in the hands of a Pathfinder agent, drawing upon a special connection to the Maze of the Open Road. In addition to the effects of a _wayfinder_, a _homeward wayfinder_ attunes itself to the most recent Pathfinder Lodge you've visited and has the following activation.

**Activate** <actions string="" /> 10 minutes (command, Interact);  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You teleport back to the attuned Pathfinder Lodge, as long as you are no more than 100 miles away. This [teleportation](/Traits.aspx?ID=156) effect fails if you would bring another creature with you, even if you're carrying it in an [extradimensional](/Traits.aspx?ID=67) space.

</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />

<row gap="medium">

</row>

**Access** Member of the Pathfinder Society.

</column>

---

_Hummingbird wayfinders_ blend a few Arcadian secrets into the original _wayfinder_ design, allowing the _wayfinder_ to gain mobility for a time and act as a spy. In addition to the effects of a _wayfinder_, a _hummingbird wayfinder_ has the following activation.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> command, Interact;  **Frequency** once per hour;   **Effect** You cause the _wayfinder_ to transform into a Tiny bee hummingbird, only 2 inches long. Other than the _wayfinder_ being a visible bird, this has the effects of [_prying eye_](/Spells.aspx?ID=239). In addition to [Seeking](/Actions.aspx?ID=84) through the hummingbird, you can activate any [_aeon stone_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=407) within the _wayfinder_ as if the _wayfinder_ were still on your person. When the effect ends, the _wayfinder_ transforms back to normal in its current position. Damaging the bird ends the effect but does not destroy the _wayfinder_.

fields.text: Item 2+ Wayfinder Source Core Rulebook pg. 617 This compact compass repurposes ancient technology to draw fantastic powers from the mysterious magical items called aeon stones . It serves as a badge of office for agents of the Pathfinder Society and as a status symbol among adventurers of any stripe. Item 2 Wayfinder Uncommon Evocation Invested Magical Source Core Rulebook pg. 617 PFS Note All Pathfinders have access. Price 28 gp Usage worn This compact compass repurposes ancient technology to draw fantastic powers from the mysterious magical items called aeon stones . It serves as a badge of office for agents of the Pathfinder Society and as a status symbol among adventurers of any stripe. A wayfinder functions as a compass. An indentation in the middle of the wayfinder can hold a single aeon stone . Placing an aeon stone in this indentation provides you all the benefits of having the aeon stone orbiting your head, but it protects the stone from being noticed or stolen as easily. You invest a wayfinder and the aeon stone within it simultaneously, and they count as only one item toward your investiture limit. An invested aeon stone slotted in a wayfinder also grants its resonant power. If you have more than one wayfinder with an invested aeon stone on your person at a given time, destructive interference from their resonance prevents you from gaining benefits from any of them. You can still benefit from additional aeon stones orbiting your head, just not in wayfinders . Activate Single Action command; Effect The wayfinder is targeted by a 1st-level light spell. Item 2 Archaic Wayfinder Uncommon Evocation Invested Magical Source World Guide pg. 17 PFS Note All characters have access to the archaic wayfinder Price 30 gp Usage held in 1 hand Activate Cast a Spell An archaic wayfinder functions as a compass and acts as a repository for one cantrip cast into it. To fill an archaic wayfinder , a spellcaster casts the chosen cantrip into the empty device, providing any necessary cost; the spell cannot be one that is normally cast as a free action or reaction. Activating an archaic wayfinder is the same as the casting for the relevant spell. Once it has been activated, it becomes empty again. An archaic wayfinder can hold an aeon stone and activate its resonant power. An archaic wayfinder counts against the limit of one wayfinder with a slotted resonant aeon stone . Item 4 Wayfinder of Rescue Uncommon Evocation Invested Magical Source PFS Scenario #1-03: Escaping the Grave pg. 42 Price 80 gp Usage worn As a standard wayfinder , but once per day you can activate it to cast heal on a creature other than yourself, using either the one-action or two-action version of heal as a 1st-level spell. Item 6 Bi-Resonant Wayfinder Uncommon Evocation Illusion Invested Magical Source Character Guide pg. 110 Price 200 gp Usage worn Access A character who is a member of the Pathfinder Society has access to this option. A bi-resonant wayfinder is inlaid with intricate platinum wires in a complex array of conduits for magical energy. These conduits control the resonant interference of aeon stones . A bi-resonant wayfinder works just like a regular wayfinder except it has two aeon stone slots, and the aeon stones in both slots grant their resonant powers without interfering with each other. The bi-resonant wayfinder and the two aeon stones count as two items toward your investiture limit. Item 4 Shining Wayfinder Uncommon Abjuration Divination Evocation Invested Magical Source Character Guide pg. 111 Price 100 gp Usage worn Access A character who is a member of the Pathfinder Society has access to this option. A shining wayfinder is a polished silver compass blessed by the power of benevolent deities. It has the usual functions of a wayfinder , except instead of an activation to cast light , the shining wayfinder has the following two activations. Activate Two Actions command, Interact; Effect You hold the wayfinder and ask for guidance. The wayfinder casts guidance on you. Activate Two Actions command, Interact; Frequency once per day; Effect You call upon the wayfinder’s divine blessings for yourself and your allies. The wayfinder casts bless , with an emanation centered on itself. Once per turn, you can use a single action, which has the concentrate trait, to increase the emanation’s radius by 5 feet. Item 5 Vanishing Wayfinder Uncommon Evocation Illusion Invested Magical Source Character Guide pg. 112 Price 150 gp Usage worn Access A character who is a member of the Pathfinder Society has access to this option. A vanishing wayfinder is crafted of ivory chased with gold and silver. It has the usual functions of a wayfinder and the following additional activation. Activate Two Actions command, Interact; Frequency once per day; Effect You turn the wayfinder in a circle while invoking its command word, gaining the effects of a 2nd-level invisibility spell for 5 minutes. Item 6 Chronicler Wayfinder Uncommon Evocation Invested Magical Source PFS Guide pg. 30 PFS Note Players can gain access to faction-specific gear by taking the corresponding Faction Gear Access Game Reward, available when they reach 20 reputation with the respective faction. Price 200 gp Usage worn Access Member of the Pathfinder Society. Chronicler wayfinders bear a mystical connection to the Pathfinder Chronicles themselves, granting them the ability to assist in situations where unusual lore is needed by drawing on lore from a particular topic. Each chronicler wayfinder is attuned to a specific Lore skill, chosen at the time of creation. In addition to the effects of a wayfinder , a chronicler wayfinder has the following activation. Activate Single Action envision; Effect You tap into the Pathfinder Chronicles on the chronicler wayfinder's attuned topic, gaining the effects of a Recall Knowledge action with the chosen Lore skill. For the Lore check's modifier, use whichever is better of +12 or your own modifier, using your level as your proficiency bonus even if you're untrained in the attuned Lore skill. Item 10 Razmiri Wayfinder Uncommon Illusion Magical Necromancy Source PFS Guide pg. 72 Price 900 gp Usage worn Worn on a chain around the neck, a Razmiri wayfinder functions as a compass and provides its wearer a +1 item bonus to Deception checks to Lie or Impersonate. Razmiri wayfinders can also be used to grant temporary healing, making it easier for the wearer to impersonate a divine spellcaster. Activate Single Action envision; Frequency three times per day; Effect You touch an adjacent creature, granting them 3d8 temporary Hit Points for 1 hour. Activate Single Action manipulate; Frequency once per day; Effect You touch an adjacent creature and attempt a counteract check against one poison or disease afflicting the creature. On a success, you halt the effects of the poison or disease for 1 day, rather than removing it. This temporarily relieves any penalties imposed by the affliction but doesn't cure the effect or count against its duration; the poison or disease is merely halted for a time, and it resumes where it left off once this effect ends. Item 9 Elemental Wayfinder (Air) Uncommon Air Evocation Invested Magical Source PFS Guide pg. 122 PFS Note All characters affiliated with the Pathfinder Society have access to this item Price 650 gp Usage worn Access Member of the Pathfinder Society. Pathfinder Society researchers recently created elemental wayfinders with the assistance of the Society's elemental allies. In addition to the effects of a wayfinder , these wayfinders each grant the ability to cast a particular elemental spell once per day, and can assist Pathfinders in exploring areas associated with their element. Additionally, you can cast feather fall as a primal innate spell once every 10 minutes. Activate Two Actions command; Frequency once per day; Effect The wayfinder casts a 4th-level lightning bolt . Item 9 Elemental Wayfinder (Earth) Uncommon Earth Evocation Invested Magical Source PFS Guide pg. 122 PFS Note All characters affiliated with the Pathfinder Society have access to this item Price 600 gp Usage worn Access Member of the Pathfinder Society. Pathfinder Society researchers recently created elemental wayfinders with the assistance of the Society's elemental allies. In addition to the effects of a wayfinder , these wayfinders each grant the ability to cast a particular elemental spell once per day, and can assist Pathfinders in exploring areas associated with their element. Additionally, you dig twice as quickly as normal. Activate Two Actions command; Frequency once per day; Effect The wayfinder casts a 4th-level stoneskin . Item 9 Elemental Wayfinder (Fire) Uncommon Evocation Fire Invested Magical Source PFS Guide pg. 122 PFS Note All characters affiliated with the Pathfinder Society have access to this item Price 700 gp Usage worn Access Member of the Pathfinder Society. Pathfinder Society researchers recently created elemental wayfinders with the assistance of the Society's elemental allies. In addition to the effects of a wayfinder , these wayfinders each grant the ability to cast a particular elemental spell once per day, and can assist Pathfinders in exploring areas associated with their element. Additionally, you gain resistance 5 to fire. Activate Two Actions command; Frequency once per day; Effect The wayfinder casts a 4th-level fireball . Item 10 Elemental Wayfinder (Water) Uncommon Evocation Invested Magical Water Source PFS Guide pg. 122 PFS Note All characters affiliated with the Pathfinder Society have access to this item Price 900 gp Usage worn Access Member of the Pathfinder Society. Pathfinder Society researchers recently created elemental wayfinders with the assistance of the Society's elemental allies. In addition to the effects of a wayfinder , these wayfinders each grant the ability to cast a particular elemental spell once per day, and can assist Pathfinders in exploring areas associated with their element. Additionally, you gain the constant effects of water breathing . Activate Two Actions command; Frequency once per day; Effect The wayfinder casts a 4th-level hydraulic torrent . Item 3 Fashionable Wayfinder Uncommon Conjuration Invested Magical Source PFS Guide pg. 122 PFS Note All characters affiliated with the Pathfinder Society have access to this item Price 50 gp Usage worn Access Member of the Pathfinder Society. Fashionable wayfinders allow you to be dressed for success in almost any situation. In addition to the effects of a wayfinder , a fashionable wayfinder can attune to up to three sets of mundane clothing in your possession during your daily preparations. A fashionable wayfinder has the following activation. Activate Single Action envision; Effect You call one of the attuned sets of clothing onto yourself, changing clothes instantly and leaving you either holding the old set of clothing or with the old set folded neatly on the floor if you don't have a free hand to hold it. This activation can't change you into or out of a suit of armor of any kind. While the activation can transport the chosen attuned set of clothing onto you from up to 60 feet away, it can't transport any other creatures or items that might have been stored in the clothing. Item 13 Homeward Wayfinder Uncommon Conjuration Evocation Invested Magical Teleportation Source PFS Guide pg. 122 PFS Note All characters affiliated with the Pathfinder Society have access to this item Price 2,750 gp Usage worn Access Member of the Pathfinder Society. Homeward wayfinders are powerful escape tools in the hands of a Pathfinder agent, drawing upon a special connection to the Maze of the Open Road. In addition to the effects of a wayfinder , a homeward wayfinder attunes itself to the most recent Pathfinder Lodge you've visited and has the following activation. Activate 10 minutes (command, Interact); Frequency once per day; Effect You teleport back to the attuned Pathfinder Lodge, as long as you are no more than 100 miles away. This teleportation effect fails if you would bring another creature with you, even if you're carrying it in an extradimensional space. Item 12 Hummingbird Wayfinder Uncommon Evocation Invested Magical Transmutation Source PFS Guide pg. 122 PFS Note All characters affiliated with the Pathfinder Society have access to this item Price 1,750 gp Usage worn Access Member of the Pathfinder Society. Hummingbird wayfinders blend a few Arcadian secrets into the original wayfinder design, allowing the wayfinder to gain mobility for a time and act as a spy. In addition to the effects of a wayfinder , a hummingbird wayfinder has the following activation. Activate Two Actions command, Interact; Frequency once per hour; Effect You cause the wayfinder to transform into a Tiny bee hummingbird, only 2 inches long. Other than the wayfinder being a visible bird, this has the effects of prying eye . In addition to Seeking through the hummingbird, you can activate any aeon stone within the wayfinder as if the wayfinder were still on your person. When the effect ends, the wayfinder transforms back to normal in its current position. Damaging the bird ends the effect but does not destroy the wayfinder .

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 110

_[**PFS Note**](/pathfinder-society) Items which can be used once per week, may be used once per scenario or adventure in Pathfinder Society play._

**Price** 240 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Typically created by [wizards](/Classes.aspx?ID=12) who are hobbyists or professional architects, an _architect's pattern book_ allows the caster  to customize certain spells that create magical structures or domiciles, adding recreational areas such as an indoor bathhouse, gaming room, swimming pool, or similar luxury.

**Activate** <actions string="Free Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [spellshape](/Traits.aspx?ID=513)) **Frequency** once per week;   **Effect** If your next action is to cast a [_cozy cabin_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1474), [_planar palace_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1634), or [_resplendent mansion_](/Spells.aspx?ID=2018) spell, you add a room to the structure that is up to 10 feet per side per rank of the spell. This room is outfitted with all the accoutrements for a particular type of recreation, determined by you when you cast the spell. Any character who spends at least 1 hour using this recreational facility and then sleeps a full 8 hours inside the location created by the spell is exceptionally well-rested. They regain double the amount of Hit Points they would normally receive for an 8-hour rest, and when they make the next day’s preparations, they gain a +1 circumstance bonus to [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) checks and Will saves for the next 12 hours.

</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Apex" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=10" />
<trait label="Divination" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=47" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Secrets of Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=96) pg. 179

**Price** 24,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn eyepiece

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This strange contraption slides over your eyes, supernaturally sharpening your mind. While peering through it, you can feel some entity whispering to you, telling all sorts of things about the subject of your gaze. You gain a +3 item bonus to [Occultism](/Skills.aspx?ID=11) (though some entities might grant a bonus to a different skill, as determined by your GM). In addition, when you employ an exploration tactic other than Investigating, you also gain the benefits of [Investigating](/Actions.aspx?ID=516) unless you choose not to.

 When you invest the spectacles, you either increase your Intelligence score by 2 or increase it to 18, whichever would give you the higher score. This gives you additional trained skills and languages, as normal for increasing your Intelligence score. You must select skills and languages the first time you invest the item, and whenever you invest the same _archivist's gaze_, you get the same skills and languages you chose the first time.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> command, Interact;  **Frequency** once per hour;   **Effect** Pushing the glasses up your nose and asking the entity for help, you cause the spectacles to cast either [_true seeing_](/Spells.aspx?ID=344) or a 3rd-level [_comprehend language_](/Spells.aspx?ID=46) on you. Because the entity tied to the spectacles chooses which one, the GM picks whichever spell is most immediately useful in your current situation (and chooses the most useful language each time the item casts _comprehend language_). The spell lasts for 1 minute.

</column>

<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Impossible Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=355) pg. 226

**Price** 24,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn eyepiece

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This strange contraption slides over your eyes, supernaturally sharpening your mind. While peering through it, you can feel some entity whispering to you, telling all sorts of things about the subject of your gaze. You gain a +3 item bonus to [Occultism](/Skills.aspx?ID=44) (though some entities might grant a bonus to a different skill, as determined by your GM). In addition, when you employ an exploration tactic other than [Investigating](/Actions.aspx?ID=2627), you also gain the benefits of Investigating unless you choose not to. When you invest the spectacles, you either increase your Intelligence modifier by 1 or increase it to +4, whichever would give you the higher value. This gives you additional trained skills and languages, as normal for increasing your Intelligence modifier. You must select skills and languages the first time you invest the item, and whenever you invest the same _archivist’s gaze_, you get the same skills and languages you picked the first time. 

**Activate—Aid from Beyond** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per hour;   **Effect** Adjusting the eyepiece’s focus and asking the entity for help, you cause the spectacles to cast either [_see the unseen_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1663) or a 3rd-rank [_translate_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1723) on you. Because the entity tied to the spectacles chooses which one, the GM picks whichever spell is most immediately useful in your current situation (and chooses the most useful language each time the item casts _translate_). The spell lasts for 1 minute.

</title>

<traits>

<trait label="Tattoo" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=262" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Impossible Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=355) pg. 241

**Price** 350 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** tattooed on the body

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

These tattoos take the form of an eye nestled within a triangle and are usually worn on the brow; their inks are said to be distilled from rare materials found only within the Crux of Nex. However, their popularity casts some doubt upon this claim. When you target a [concealed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=62) creature with a magical effect or spell, you reduce the DC of the [flat check](/Rules.aspx?ID=333) to 3. 

**Activate—Open the Eye** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** For the next 10 minutes, you gain an [imprecise magic sense](/Rules.aspx?ID=2407) with a range of 30 feet. This allows you to detect spells, magical effects, and magical items within range. You also learn the rank or level of such magical effects and their traits. Deceptive illusion magic is not detectable by this magic sense.

>
[Arclord's Codex](/Equipment.aspx?ID=5119)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Grimoire" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=387" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Impossible Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=355) pg. 228

**Price** 38,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

The techniques bound in the spellbooks of the Arclords of Nex are jealously guarded secrets, and an Arclord gives up their grimoire only under the direst of circumstances. These grimoires vary in appearance based on their owner’s taste, but all display the Arclords’ symbol of an eye within a triangle on the cover. Possession of an _Arclord’s codex_ signifies mastery of powerful magic, and anyone who steals such a tome is sure to find themself hunted across the world—or [the multiverse](/Rules.aspx?ID=2988), if necessary—by its owner. 

**Activate—Third Eye Rejuvenation** <actions string="Free Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [spellshape](/Traits.aspx?ID=513)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** If your next action is to [Cast a prepared](/Actions.aspx?ID=3521) 10th-rank [arcane](/SpellLists.aspx?Tradition=1) spell, the magical energies reinvigorate your spellcasting. You regain access to two spells of 4th rank or lower or one spell of 5th rank or higher that you’ve prepared and already cast today.

</column>

---

This tattoo takes the shape of the face of a roaring polar bear with piercing, ice-blue eyes. You don't take damage from [extreme cold or severe cold](/Rules.aspx?ID=642).

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> command;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You call forth a blast of polar wind in a 10-foot burst within a range of 30 feet that deals 7d6 cold damage. All creatures in the area must attempt a DC 27 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Fortitude save.

<traits>

<row gap="medium">

**Bulk** 4

</row>

<row gap="medium">

---

This tower shield is crafted from interlocking sections of an arctic cave worm’s chitin that are rimed with constant frost. It has Hardness 13, HP 104, and BT 52.

**Activate—Misty Chill** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([cold](/Traits.aspx?ID=555), [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645))    **Effect** You [Raise the Shield](/Actions.aspx?ID=2316) and an icy mist begins to flow off it. Until the beginning of your next turn, you gain [resistance](/Rules.aspx?ID=2318) 5 to cold and any creature that ends its turn adjacent to you takes 3d6 cold damage (DC 29 basic Reflex save).

**Craft Requirements** The initial raw materials must include chitin from an arctic [cave worm](/Monsters.aspx?ID=2871).

---

Skilled awl work has imprinted images of a muscled weightlifter into these tiered leather bands, which grant you enhanced stamina and skill when performing athletic exercises. While fastened to your upper arms, the armbands give you a +2 item bonus to Athletics checks. In addition, whenever you use an action to [Climb](/Actions.aspx?ID=33) or [Swim](/Actions.aspx?ID=39) and you succeed at the Athletics check, add a +5-foot item bonus to the distance you move.

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 17"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Armbands of the Gorgon](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2133)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Apex" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=10" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 102

**Price** 15,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn armbands

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Each of these shining, bluish-gray metal armbands is adorned with the plated visage of a [gorgon's](/Monsters.aspx?ID=686) head. When targeted by a spell or effect with the [incapacitation](/Traits.aspx?ID=93) effect, you treat the result of your save as if it were one degree of success better, and the result of any check made to inflict such an effect on you as one degree of success worse (as if you were more than twice the rank of the spell or effect targeting you). When you invest the armbands, you either increase your Constitution modifier by 1 or increase it to +4, whichever would give you a higher value.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You clap the bracers together and remove a single condition of your choice currently afflicting you. If the condition is permanent, it's instead suppressed for 1 hour.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

>
[Armor of the Holy Warrior](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1562)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Divine" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=48" />
<trait label="Good" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=83" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Necromancy" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=117" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Knights of Lastwall](/Sources.aspx?ID=123) pg. 88

**Price** 9,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn armor

**Bulk** 3
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Armor** [Half Plate](/Armor.aspx?ID=12)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Based on the armors used by the holy warriors who served under General Arnisant in the Shining Crusade, this well-polished _+2 [greater resilient](/Equipment.aspx?ID=279) [half plate](/Armor.aspx?ID=12)_ is decorated with religious motifs and carved with sacred scripture. While wearing _armor of the holy warrior_, your item bonus from the _greater resilient_ rune increases from +2 to +3; if you upgrade to a _major resilient_ rune, the item bonus instead increases from +3 to +4. An [undead](/Traits.aspx?ID=160) that critically fails an [unarmed](/Traits.aspx?ID=199) attack against you while you wear this armor takes 1d6 positive damage.

 If you are evil, you're [enfeebled 2](/Conditions.aspx?ID=13) while wearing the armor. If you're undead, you also take 2d6 positive damage each round that you wear the armor.

**Activate** <actions string="Three Actions" /> Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The armor casts the three-action version of a 6th-level [_heal_](/Spells.aspx?ID=148) spell.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

---

This kit can be used to clean and polish armor. Creatures wearing armor that has been maintained by this kit gain a +1 circumstance bonus on [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) checks to [Make an Impression](/Actions.aspx?ID=50) on soldiers, guards, [Gorumites](/Deities.aspx?ID=7), and other martially minded characters. This bonus expires after 24 hours, or if the armor is soiled in some way, such as by walking through a sewer or falling in a mud pit.

---

Magic wards deflect attacks. Increase the armor’s item bonus to AC by 1. The armor can be etched with one property rune.

 You can upgrade the _armor potency_ rune already etched on a suit of armor to a stronger version, increasing the values of the existing rune to those of the new rune. You must have the formula of the stronger rune to do so, and the Price of the upgrade is the difference between the two runes’ Prices.

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 0"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Armored Skirt](/Equipment.aspx?ID=514)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Character Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=12) pg. 91

**Price** 2 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

These armor-plated skirts, which are also known as armored kilts, are favored by Knights of Lastwall for their versatility and aesthetic appeal. An armored skirt can be donned with 2 Interact actions when it’s worn with light or medium armor, or as part of donning heavy armor.

 When worn with a [breastplate](/Armor.aspx?ID=47), [chain shirt](/Armor.aspx?ID=43), [chain mail](/Armor.aspx?ID=46), or [scale mail](/Armor.aspx?ID=45), an armored skirt increases the armor’s item bonus to AC by 1, worsens the armor’s [check penalty](/Rules.aspx?ID=2173) by 1, reduces the armor’s Dex cap by 1, increases the [Strength](/Rules.aspx?ID=2175) score required to ignore the check penalty and reduce the [Speed penalty](/Rules.aspx?ID=2174) by 2, and adds the [noisy](/Traits.aspx?ID=660) trait. This also makes the armor one step heavier (from light to medium, or medium to heavy), and you use the proficiency bonus appropriate to this adjusted armor type.

 Alternatively, when wearing an armored skirt to replace appropriate portions of a set of [half plate](/Armor.aspx?ID=49) or [full plate](/Armor.aspx?ID=50), reduce the armor’s item bonus to AC by 1, lessen the check penalty by 1, decrease the Strength score required to ignore the check penalty and reduce the Speed penalty by 2, increase the armor’s Dex cap by 1, and add the noisy trait to the armor. An armored skirt grants no benefit when worn by itself or with armors other than those listed here.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

[Armorskin Robes](/Equipment.aspx?ID=5241)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=637" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Cheliax, Infernal Inheritence](/Sources.aspx?ID=372) pg. 104

**Price** 700 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn garment

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Armor** [Explorer's Clothing](/Armor.aspx?ID=39)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This _[+1 resilient](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2804) [explorer's clothing](/Armor.aspx?ID=39)_ is woven with thread spun by an elemental, and it sparkles with radiant color. You gain resistance 5 to a type of damage based on the robe's type. 

**Activate—Elemental Sheath** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The elemental threads cover your skin, further protecting you but limiting mobility. For 10 minutes, you gain resistance 5 to slashing and piercing damage but take a –5-foot status penalty to all Speeds. You also gain additional benefits based on the robe’s type.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

</title>

<traits>

</traits>

**Price** 700 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Bulk** L

</row>

</column>

---

A strong breeze wafts from the thread, blowing attacks off course. You gain resistance 5 to electricity damage. While activated, you gain a +1 status bonus to your AC against physical ranged attacks.

**Usage** worn

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

---

Several small charms shaped like weapons hang from an _armory bracelet_, which is often brass. The bracelet has one charm each for the groups [bow](/WeaponGroups.aspx?ID=3), [brawling](/WeaponGroups.aspx?ID=4), [club](/WeaponGroups.aspx?ID=5), [dart](/WeaponGroups.aspx?ID=6), [flail](/WeaponGroups.aspx?ID=7), [hammer](/WeaponGroups.aspx?ID=8), [knife](/WeaponGroups.aspx?ID=9), [pick](/WeaponGroups.aspx?ID=10), [polearm](/WeaponGroups.aspx?ID=11), [shield](/WeaponGroups.aspx?ID=12), [sling](/WeaponGroups.aspx?ID=13), [spear](/WeaponGroups.aspx?ID=14), and [sword](/WeaponGroups.aspx?ID=15). Rare versions of the armory bracelet include charms for [firearms](/WeaponGroups.aspx?ID=16).

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You pull one charm from the bracelet. The charm transforms into a weapon of your choice from the charm's weapon group. If the weapon requires ammunition, it appears with a quiver or pouch with 20 pieces of ammunition for the weapon. The weapon is a _+1 [striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=280)_ weapon of the type you chose. After 1 minute, the weapon transforms into a non-magical version and remains until your next daily preparations. At that point, the weapon and any remaining ammunition crumble to dust and all the charms reappear on the bracelet. The weapon and ammunition created with the charm are noticeably different from others and can't be sold.

The bracelet has one charm each for the groups [bow](/WeaponGroups.aspx?ID=3), [brawling](/WeaponGroups.aspx?ID=4), [club](/WeaponGroups.aspx?ID=5), [dart](/WeaponGroups.aspx?ID=6), [flail](/WeaponGroups.aspx?ID=7), [hammer](/WeaponGroups.aspx?ID=8), [knife](/WeaponGroups.aspx?ID=9), [pick](/WeaponGroups.aspx?ID=10), [polearm](/WeaponGroups.aspx?ID=11), [shield](/WeaponGroups.aspx?ID=12), [sling](/WeaponGroups.aspx?ID=13), [spear](/WeaponGroups.aspx?ID=14), and [sword](/WeaponGroups.aspx?ID=15). Rare versions of the _armory bracelet_ include charms for [firearms](/WeaponGroups.aspx?ID=16).

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> envision, Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You pull one charm from the bracelet. The charm transforms into a weapon of your choice from the charm’s weapon group. If the weapon requires ammunition, it appears with a quiver or pouch with 20 pieces of ammunition for the weapon. The weapon is a _[+1 striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2861) weapon_ of the type you chose. After 1 minute, the weapon transforms into a non-magical version and remains until your next daily preparations. At that point, the weapon and any remaining ammunition crumble to dust and all the charms reappear on the bracelet. The weapon and ammunition created with the charm are noticeably different from others and can’t be sold.

</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Extinction Curse</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Unique" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=161" />
<trait label="Arcane" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=11" />
<trait label="Artifact" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=253" />
<trait label="Enchantment" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=61" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #156: The Apocalypse Prophet](/Sources.aspx?ID=36) pg. 66

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This coin-sized gemstone can be used on its own but must be included in the construction of a hearth in order to fully activate its magic.

**Activate** <actions string="" /> 3 days (Interact);  **Frequency** 4 times per year;  **Requirements** You have Legendary proficiency in [Crafting](/Skills.aspx?ID=4); **Effect** You craft a magical weapon or armor of up to 20th level. You must attempt a Crafting check as usual to create the item, but you need supply only raw materials worth a quarter of the item's Price, and you need not pay the remaining portion of the item's Price or spend additional downtime days working on it. While _Aroden's Hearthstone_ is active, the stars in the sky, including Golarion's sun, appear to glow brighter within a 100-mile radius of the hearthstone.

**Activate** <actions string="Three Actions" /> command, envision;  **Frequency** once per month;   **Effect** _Aroden's Hearthstone_ draws in heat from the world itself, causing the ambient temperature within 100 miles to drop below 0°F. Within 1 mile of the _Hearthstone_, the temperature drops to –200°F, rivaling the frigid cold of outer space and dealing 4d6 cold damage each round to every creature in the area. This effect lasts 1 minute, during which time the nearest moon (probably Golarion's) appears an eerie blue color to any observers within 100 miles of the hearthstone. At the end of 1 minute, the hearthstone emits a blast of concentrated heat that deals 25d6 fire damage to creatures and objects within 150 feet. 

**Destruction** Using Aroden_'s Hearthstone_ to craft a cursed item results in a failed creation and causes the gemstone to split into five equal-sized but magically impotent pieces. Over the course of a year, four of theses pieces crumble to dust, while the fifth expands to the size of the original artifact and bears its powers anew. To destroy _Aroden's Hearthstone_, each of the separated pieces must be plunged into one of the five stars that compose the cosmic constellation known as the Follower.

</column>

This oily mix of herbs and natural detergents can be applied to a creature to reduce and cover any ordinary odors they produce. The creature receives a +2 item bonus to [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=48) checks to [Hide](/Actions.aspx?ID=2404) or [Sneak](/Actions.aspx?ID=2405) against creatures using primarily smell. ---

The components of this ammunition emit a strong smell when combined during its activation. A creature hit by an activated aromatic ammunition gains a distinct odor for up to 1 hour or until the scent is washed off (requiring at least a gallon of water and 10 minutes of scrubbing). Any creatures within 30 feet smell the target, allowing even those with a weak sense of smell to detect its presence, and all creatures gain a +1 item bonus to [Track](/Actions.aspx?ID=66) the affected creature for as long as it has the odor. A creature that has imprecise or precise [scent](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=33) doubles the range at which they can detect the target using their scent compared to the normal range of their scent.

    level="1"
    right="Item 3"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Artevil Suspension](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1658)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Alchemical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=6" />
<trait label="Consumable" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=36" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Travel Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=141) pg. 101

_[**PFS Note**](/pathfinder-society) The DC to remove the sickened condition from an artevil suspension is the standard DC for an item of its level (in this case, DC 17)._

**Price** 11 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><row>[Treat Poison](/Actions.aspx?ID=56)</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This dried herb is known for its ability to draw toxins from the body, albeit violently. You can administer the suspension orally, Activating the item as part of the same activity you use to Treat Poison. If you succeed at your [Medicine](/Skills.aspx?ID=9) check to Treat Poison against an [ingested](/Traits.aspx?ID=95) poison, you can reduce the stage of the toxin by one stage, though this can't reduce the stage below stage 1 or cure the poison entirely. If you do, the creature becomes [sickened 2](/Conditions.aspx?ID=34) as its body purges the toxin. An artevil suspension doesn't work unless the poison was administered through ingestion; for instance, if a poison can be administered through either ingestion or injury and was administered through injury, the suspension won't work.

</column>

    pfs="Standard"
>
[Artificer Spectacles](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2134)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Apex" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=10" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 102

**Price** 15,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn eyepiece

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

These seemingly ordinary rectangular eyeglasses feature clear lenses framed in copper. When invested and worn, they rest perfectly on the bridge of the nose and can only be removed by the wearer. You gain a +3 item bonus to [Crafting](/Skills.aspx?ID=4) checks and any skill check made to [Identify Magic](/Actions.aspx?ID=24). When you invest the spectacles, you either increase your Intelligence modifier by 1 or increase it to +4, whichever would give you a higher value. You must select the skills and languages the first time you invest the item, and whenever you invest the same _artificer spectacles_, you get the same skills and languages you chose the first time.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per hour;   **Effect** You cast a 3rd-rank [_mending_](/Spells.aspx?ID=189) spell on an item you touch.

You need this toolkit to create items from raw materials with the [Craft](/Actions.aspx?ID=43) skill. Different sets are needed for different work, as determined by the GM; for example, a blacksmith's toolkit differs from a woodworker's toolkit. If you wear your artisan's toolkit, you can draw and replace it as part of the action that uses it.

You can use a toolkit with 1 hand if you’re wearing it or 2 if you’re holding it. [See here for details](/Rules.aspx?ID=2207).

May contain spoilers from Bastion of Blasphemies **Source** [Pathfinder #224: Bastion of Blasphemies](/Sources.aspx?ID=357) pg. 235 **Usage** held in 1 hand **Bulk** 1 --- Each _Arudora memento_ is unique in appearance, but all seven are approximately the same size. Carried by each of the cursed family members, these mementos have within them the power to unlock entire portions of Bastardhall from the ghostly cursed state the castle traditionally exists in. Each of the seven mementos has the following activation, but the section of castle unlocked by each activation, as well as each memento’s specific benefit granted to the PCs, varies by type. **Activate—Return Memento** ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Effect** You place the memento into the appropriate statue’s clutches in the fountain located in area
**B3** of Bastardhall. The statue briefly animates to claim the memento, which turns to stone and becomes thereafter a permanent part of the statue, effectively destroying the memento while granting a boon to the party that persists for the remainder of this Adventure Path. A section of Bastardhall solidifies from its ghostly form, unlocking its reaches for the PCs to explore. **Destruction** An _Arudora memento_ is destroyed when it’s activated with Return Memento, and the boon it grants upon this returning lasts until the very end of the Adventure Path. Alisendra's Fan **Source** [Pathfinder #224: Bastion of Blasphemies](/Sources.aspx?ID=357) pg. 235 **Bulk** L --- When this elegant crimson hand fan is Returned, the dungeon (detailed in Chapter 5) is unlocked. The souls trapped in Bastardhall appreciate the end of Alisendra’s dominion and now whisper hints of truths in the ears of those who seek knowledge. The DCs for all checks made to [Recall Knowledge](/Actions.aspx?ID=2367) are reduced by 1 for the rest of the Adventure Path. Augsten's Cudgel **Source** [Pathfinder #224: Bastion of Blasphemies](/Sources.aspx?ID=357) pg. 235 **Bulk** L --- When this bloodstained wooden cudgel is Returned, the reception halls (detailed in Chapter 4) are unlocked. Sometimes, violence is the only answer, and swift action to combat is rewarded. For the rest of the Adventure Path, all PCs gain a +1 bonus to any initiative rolls; this special bonus combines with all other bonuses. Dazerien's Thumbscrew **Source** [Pathfinder #224: Bastion of Blasphemies](/Sources.aspx?ID=357) pg. 235 **Bulk** L --- When this gory bronze thumbscrew is Returned, the private halls (detailed in Chapter 6) are unlocked. Rest becomes more rewarding now that the sadist of the dungeon has been defeated. For the rest of the Adventure Path, when the PCs take their 8-hour period of rest, they recover an additional number of Hit Points equal to their Constitution modifier (minimum 1) times their level. Irrokcis's Medallion **Source** [Pathfinder #224: Bastion of Blasphemies](/Sources.aspx?ID=357) pg. 235 **Bulk** L --- When this eerie medallion is Returned, the towers (detailed in Chapter 9) are unlocked, and the spirits of those trapped in Bastardhall rise up to aid the PCs. All weapon Strikes made by PCs deal an additional 1 spirit damage for the rest of the Adventure Path. Jinnivere's Riding Crop **Source** [Pathfinder #224: Bastion of Blasphemies](/Sources.aspx?ID=357) pg. 235 **Bulk** L --- When this leather riding crop is Returned, the cellars (detailed in Chapter 3) are unlocked. Companions are now more hearty and full of life—PC companions (such as familiars, eidolons, and animal companions) gain a +1 status bonus to all saving throws for the remainder of this Adventure Path. Raudltz's Telescope **Source** [Pathfinder #224: Bastion of Blasphemies](/Sources.aspx?ID=357) pg. 235 **Bulk** L --- When this handheld telescope is Returned, the fallen temple (detailed in Chapter 7) is unlocked. Secrets are now more difficult to hide in Bastardhall. Reduce all Perception DCs made when [Seeking](/Actions.aspx?ID=2301) or [Searching](/Actions.aspx?ID=2630) by 2 for the rest of this Adventure Path. Ryhasphinea's Hourglass **Source** [Pathfinder #224: Bastion of Blasphemies](/Sources.aspx?ID=357) pg. 235 **Bulk** L --- When this cracked hourglass is Returned, the vaults (detailed in Chapter 8) are unlocked. Death’s grasp on the PCs wanes—for the rest of this Adventure Path, the DCs for all recovery checks made by a [dying](/Conditions.aspx?ID=69) PC are reduced by 2.

This masterfully crafted spirit is mixed into a potent magical cocktail and packaged in a gourd with an engraving of a forest dragon coiling around it. Drinking it imparts an intriguing balance of woodsmoke, honey, and bright floral notes on the back end. When consumed, your arms become infused with the deadly power of a forest dragon. For 1 minute, your unarmed Strikes deal an additional 1d6 poison damage and an additional 1d6 negative damage.

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 122

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn clothing

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

</column>

---

_Ash gowns_ are formal wear spun from smoke, ash, and char collected from the [Plane of Fire](/Planes.aspx?ID=6). Typically, they're voluminous floor-length dresses or three-piece suits, but regardless of their specific tailoring, _ash gowns_ are always an ostentatious display of wealth and loyalty to the powers of the Plane of Fire. They're exceptionally popular in the courts of the [Elemental Lords](/DeityCategories.aspx?ID=8) and among the high society of Medina Mudii'a. The gown grants you resistance 5 to fire and a +1 item bonus to [Intimidation](/Skills.aspx?ID=7) checks.

**Activate—Blazing Promenade** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The ash gown ignites in a ferocious blaze, flames licking the floor and trailing behind you like a dancing cape. You Stride and make a Strike at the end of your movement. During the Stride, your flames incinerate minor obstacles in your path; you ignore non-magical [difficult terrain](/Rules.aspx?ID=453), and any you move through is destroyed. Creatures that are adjacent to you at any point during your movement take 2d6 fire damage with a DC 23 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save. A creature doesn't need to attempt this save more than once, even if you move past it multiple times.

<trait label="Enchantment" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=61" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Highhelm](/Sources.aspx?ID=204) pg. 58

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** etched onto a weapon

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

In his attempts to recreate the initial feeling of the object he encountered ages ago, the Ash Engineer discovered a different effect, one that would confound his enemies. _Ashen_ weapons are typically coated in a thin layer of ash that gradually returns over the span of a day, even after wiping away. A creature hit by an attack from an _ashen_ weapon becomes surrounded by burning ash, which deals 1d4 [persistent fire damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29). This ash clouds the senses, causing the creature to become [confused](/Conditions.aspx?ID=5) for 1 round unless it succeeds at a DC 25 Will save.

_Ashes of the war god_ may be applied to armor, a weapon, or mixed into an [elixir](/Traits.aspx?ID=589) or [potion](/Traits.aspx?ID=672).

**Armor** The armor becomes [+3 major resilient](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2804) armor for 1 day. It retains any [property runes](/Rules.aspx?ID=3168).

**Elixir or Potion** In addition to the normal effects drinking the elixir or potion grant you, you gain a +3 item bonus to [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) checks and Fortitude saves for 1 hour.

**Weapon** The weapon becomes a [+3 major striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2861) weapon for 1 day. It retains any property runes.

[Assassin's Bracers](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3495)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Prey for Death</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=721" />
<trait label="Illusion" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=629" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=637" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Prey for Death](/Sources.aspx?ID=231) pg. 104

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn bracers

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

These paired bracers of red leather appear as plain armbands on the outside but display the branded symbol of [Achaekek](/Deities.aspx?ID=325) on the inside. They grant the wearer a +1 item bonus to AC and saving throws, and a maximum Dexterity modifier of +5 as armor. You can affix talismans to _assassin's bracers_ as though they were light armor.

**Activate—Focus on the Doomed** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You designate one creature within 30 feet. You cast 4th-rank [_invisibility_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1577) on yourself, but the designated creature can still see you. The bracers enhance your appearance to the designated creature, making you appear more fearsome and unnerving, granting you a +1 item bonus to attempts to Feint or Demoralize the designated creature. The designated creature takes a –1 item penalty to saving throws against fear effects.

The bracers enhance your appearance to the designated creature, making you appear more fearsome and unnerving, granting you a +1 item bonus to attempts to Feint or Demoralize the designated creature. The designated creature takes a –1 item penalty to saving throws against fear effects.

</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 12

**Price** 125 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** etched onto armor

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

---

Your armor provides support for your joints or advanced prostheses for missing limbs, holding your body in place and easing physical symptoms. This replicates the benefits of any number of [splints, supports, and prostheses](/Rules.aspx?ID=2213). When you invest the armor, you determine how many such supports you want, and where on your body they assist you.

 In addition, the extra support and structure provided by the armor allows you to transport more than you would otherwise normally be able to. You can carry Bulk equal to 6 + your Strength modifier before becoming encumbered, and you can hold and carry a total Bulk of up to 11 + your Strength modifier.

_Astral_ weapons command powerful spiritual energy from the Astral Plane. </title>

<traits>
<trait label="Alchemical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=6" />
<trait label="Consumable" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=36" />
<trait label="Contact" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=37" />
<trait label="Poison" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=126" />
<trait label="Virulent" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=162" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 67

**Price** 350 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 2 hands

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="Three Actions" /><row>([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104))</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This oily, dark-purple powder gives off the distinct odor of boiled leather. When delivered, the poison acts quickly to constrict the victim's blood flow to their extremities and turn their lungs into a soft jelly. A victim of astringent venom is recognizable by the frostbite-like hue of their hands as they lose circulation to their extremities, making it difficult for them to hold things. Astrolabes can be used for navigation in unfamiliar or featureless locations. To use an astrolabe, the holder must be trained in [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=16). By spending 1 minute to measure the height of the stars and planets, a holder who knows the time and date can determine the latitude, and a holder who knows their latitude can determine the date and time. An astrolabe also grants a +1 item bonus to checks to identify celestial bodies. A standard astrolabe functions only on steady ground.

</title>

**Price** 150 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 2 hands

**Bulk** L

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>
