<trait label="Intelligent" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=636" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #221: Into the Apocalypse Archive](/Sources.aspx?ID=371) pg. 75

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 2 hands

**Bulk** 2
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Weapon** [Halberd](/Weapons.aspx?ID=381)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Perception** +29; [darkvision](/MonsterAbilities.aspx?ID=59), imprecise hearing within 60 feet

**Communication** speech (Azlanti, Elven, Thassilonian)

**Skills** [Arcana](/Skills.aspx?ID=35) +33, [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=38) +29, [Society](/Skills.aspx?ID=47) +31

**Int** +8, **Wis** +6, **Cha** +4

**Will** +31 

</column>

---        

_Belimarius's Invidious Halberd_ is a _+3 greater striking [keen](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2843) [spell reservoir](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2849) [high-grade dawnsilver](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2917) [halberd](/Weapons.aspx?ID=381)_ (at this time, their spell reservoir contains [slow](/Spells.aspx?ID=1677)). As the halberd passed from the hands of one runelord of envy to the next, the halberd's self-loathing and hatred of the arcane spellcasters they were forced to serve grew. Their own limited arcane magic paled in comparison to their powerful wielders, after all, and the halberd seethed at this perceived inequality. They only grudgingly abide their wielders—runelord or otherwise—and are only truly happy when they're used to cut down those who can cast arcane spells. The halberd can use 3 actions per turn, acting on their wielder's turn, and has a reaction. These actions and reaction don't count against their wielder's.

**Activate—Absorb Arcana** <actions string="Reaction" />  ([arcane](/Traits.aspx?ID=534), [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561))  **Trigger** The halberd damages a creature capable of casting arcane spells;  **Effect** The halberd attempts to absorb one of the creature's prepared arcane spells or arcane spell slots. If the creature struck fails a DC 37 Will save, it loses an arcane spell (or lose an unused arcane spell slot) as if it'd cast that spell. The spell or slot lost is randomly determined from the highest rank available, starting at 6th rank and working down. The halberd passes this absorbed energy on to their wielder, who becomes [quickened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=89) for 1 round and can use the extra action only to Strike with the halberd. 

**Activate—Detonate Magic** <actions string="Two Actions" />  ([arcane](/Traits.aspx?ID=534), [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The halberd casts [detonate magic](/Spells.aspx?ID=1488) (DC 37) 

**Activate—Manipulate Mind** <actions string="Two Actions" />  ([arcane](/Traits.aspx?ID=534), [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per hour;   **Effect** The halberd casts a 9th-rank [rewrite memory](/Spells.aspx?ID=1655) (DC 37) 

**Activate—Shattermind** <actions string="Free Action" />  ([arcane](/Traits.aspx?ID=534), [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561))  **Trigger** The halberd critically hits a creature capable of casting arcane spells;  **Effect** The creature struck is targeted with a 9th-rank [never mind](/Spells.aspx?ID=1614) spell (DC 37).

**Destruction** _Belimarius’s Invidious Halberd_ is destroyed if it’s hurled under the feet of the Oliphaunt of Jandelay while there’s no current runelord of envy living in the world.

The head of this imposing steel _[+2 greater striking ](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2861) [vitalizing ](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2852) [morningstar](/Weapons.aspx?ID=363)_ is shaped to resemble a cluster of snarling orc faces, their sharpened tusks serving as the spikes. </title>

</traits>

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 145, [Pathfinder #147: Tomorrow Must Burn](/Sources.aspx?ID=8) pg. 71

<row gap="medium">

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

---

Different versions of the _bellflower toolbelt_ are customized to appear to suit specific trades, so a belt used for carpentry would look different from a belt for baking.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645))    **Effect** You place an object of up to 1 Bulk into the belt, transforming that object into a tool befitting the trade for which the belt was created. Each object remains transformed until it has been removed from the belt for 24 hours or someone uses a single Interact action to return it to its normal form. If enough transformed items are in it, the belt can be used as [artisan's tools](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3) for that trade.

Different versions of the _bellflower toolbelt_ are customized to appear to suit specific trades, so a belt used for carpentry would look different from a belt for baking.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> envision, Interact;     **Effect** You place an object of up to 1 Bulk into the belt, transforming that object into a tool befitting the trade for which the belt was created. </title>

<traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 190

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Weapon** [Dagger](/Weapons.aspx?ID=3)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

The hilt of a _bellicose dagger_ is etched with the word for “war” in various languages. Having absorbed the spirit of violence over the course of its existence, the weapon now craves bloodshed. A _bellicose dagger_ is a _+1 [striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=280) [wounding](/Equipment.aspx?ID=309) [dagger](/Weapons.aspx?ID=3)_. However, anytime you interact with creatures, no matter the context, you must succeed at a DC 25 Will save or else find you have, as a reaction, drawn the dagger.

 When you use the _bellicose dagger_ as a weapon for the first time, it fuses to you. While it's in your possession, you take a –2 circumstance penalty to [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) checks and skill checks to avoid fighting, such as [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) checks to trick your way out of a scuffle or [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) checks to sneak past enemies.

</column>

>
[Beloved's Bracelets](/Equipment.aspx?ID=4052)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Revenge of the Runelords</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=683" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=637" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
<trait label="Mythic" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=835" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #220: Crypt of Runes](/Sources.aspx?ID=284) pg. 82

**Price** 10,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><row>1 minute</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

The mightiest wizards of Eurythnia, the realm of lust, would sometimes share one of these pairs of bracelets—the silver, most often—with their closest confidantes and most trusted apprentices, while keeping the golden one for themselves. 

**Activate—Grant Mythic Power** <actions string="" /> 1 minute ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561))   **Requirements** Both bracelets are invested and the silver bracelet is not already imbued with mythic power;; **Effect** The wearer of the golden bracelet imbues the silver bracelet with a portion of their mythic power by spending 1 [Mythic Point](/Rules.aspx?ID=3323). Until the silver bracelet is no longer imbued with mythic power, the maximum number of Mythic Points the wearer of the golden bracelet can have is reduced by 1. Whenever the wearer of the silver bracelet would attempt a skill check, they can choose to make the check at mythic proficiency. If they do, the silver bracelet loses its mythic power and the wearer of the golden bracelet is immediately aware of this, regardless of the distance between the two bracelets, even if they are on different planes of existence. If the creature who had invested in the silver bracelet dies before expending the mythic power in it, the silver bracelet immediately teleports into the possession of the wearer of the golden bracelet regardless of the distance between them, even if they are on different planes of existence.

</column>

    pfs="Standard"
>
[Belt of Long Life](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3007)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Apex" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=532" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=637" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [GM Core](/Sources.aspx?ID=218) pg. 270

**Price** 15,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn belt

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This thick leather belt is engraved with imagery of an ancient tree. You gain 15 temporary Hit Points the first time you invest the belt in a day. When you invest the belt, you either increase your Constitution modifier by 1 or increase it to +4, whichever would give you a higher value. 

**Activate—Call Upon the Ancient Life** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You draw upon the life- giving energy of the tree on the belt to gain rapid healing. For 2d4 rounds, at the start of your turn each round, you recover 15 Hit Points.

</column>

[Belt of Regeneration](/Equipment.aspx?ID=399)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Apex" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=10" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Transmutation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=157" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 603

**Price** 15,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn belt

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This belt is crafted from rubbery troll hide that’s green and orange in color. You gain 15 temporary Hit Points the first time you invest the belt in a day. When you invest the belt, you either increase your Constitution score by 2 or increase it to 18, whichever would give you a higher score.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You tighten the belt one notch to gain a regeneration effect. For 2d4 rounds, at the start of your turn each round, you recover 15 Hit Points unless you took acid or fire damage since the start of your previous turn.

</column>

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 9"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Belt of the Five Kings](/Equipment.aspx?ID=410)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Enchantment" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=61" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 606

**Price** 650 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn belt

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Made from interlocking plates of silver and gold, this heavy belt bears stylized miniature images of five kingly dwarves. You gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Diplomacy checks to Make an Impression with dwarves or make a Request from dwarves. You also gain a +1 circumstance bonus to Intimidation checks against giants and orcs.

 The belt also grants you darkvision and the ability to understand, speak, and write the Dwarven language.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;  **Requirements** You are a dwarf; **Effect** You tighten the belt one notch to gain temporary Hit Points equal to your level and grant allies within 20 feet of you darkvision. Both effects last for 10 minutes.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

</title>

<traits>

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="Single Action" /><row>([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104))</row></row>

---

Your limbs become extremely limber, letting you stretch and twist to extreme degrees at the cost of fine motor skills. 

**Benefit** You gain the listed item bonus to [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) checks to [Escape](/Actions.aspx?ID=79), [Squeeze](/Actions.aspx?ID=31), and [Tumble Through](/Actions.aspx?ID=29), and you increase your reach by the listed amount. 

**Drawback** You take a –1 penalty to [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) checks, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) checks, [Thievery](/Skills.aspx?ID=17) checks, and attack rolls, and a –1 penalty per damage die to all weapon and [unarmed](/Traits.aspx?ID=199) attack damage.

<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="Single Action" /><row>([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104))</row></row>

---

Your limbs become extremely limber, letting you stretch and twist to extreme degrees at the cost of fine motor skills. 

**Benefit** You gain the listed item bonus to [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=1) checks to [Escape](/Actions.aspx?ID=79), [Squeeze](/Actions.aspx?ID=31), and [Tumble Through](/Actions.aspx?ID=29), and you increase your reach by the listed amount. 

**Drawback** You take a –1 penalty to [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3) checks, [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=15) checks, [Thievery](/Skills.aspx?ID=17) checks, and attack rolls, and a –1 penalty per damage die to all weapon and [unarmed](/Traits.aspx?ID=199) attack damage.

    right="Item 17"

>
[Benthic Drums](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3926)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Battlecry!](/Sources.aspx?ID=268) pg. 142

**Price** 14,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 2 hands

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This large bass drum is made of driftwood and whale hide, with swirling shapes that hint at more distinct and sinister forms carved on its surface. This drum grants you a +2 item bonus to [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=45) checks while playing music with the instrument. You can communicate basic ideas with whales and other large sea animals by playing music with this instrument.

**Activate—Call from the Depths** <actions string="Three Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=590), [fear](/Traits.aspx?ID=598), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647), [sonic](/Traits.aspx?ID=697)) **Frequency** once per week;   **Effect** You drum a song of an ancient creature, calling forth the cries of a great whale in the minds of your foes. All enemies in a 60-foot [emanation](/Rules.aspx?ID=2387) take 9d10 sonic damage (DC 36 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=2297) Will save). Creatures who fail are also [frightened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=76) 1.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

**Source** [Player Core 2](/Sources.aspx?ID=227) pg. 310 **Usage** worn cloak **Bulk** 1 --- This bearskin includes the head and bared teeth of the mighty creature from which it was taken. When worn, the cloak drapes over your head and around your shoulders, imbuing you with a bear's ferocity. If you have the [Rage](/Actions.aspx?ID=2802) action, while raging, you grow jaws that deal 1d10 piercing damage and claws that deal 1d6 slashing damage and have the [agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=526) trait. This transformation is a morph effect, and both the jaws and claws are unarmed attacks in the brawling weapon group. You gain the benefits of a +1 _[weapon potency rune](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2830)_ and a _[striking rune](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2829)_ with these attacks (gaining a +1 item bonus to attack rolls and increasing the number of weapon damage dice by one).
If you have an [animal instinct](/Instincts.aspx?ID=1) and the bestial rage instinct ability, instead of gaining these unarmed attacks, your unarmed attacks from the bestial rage instinct ability gain the benefits of a _+2 [weapon potency rune](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2830)_ and a _[greater striking rune](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2829) _ (granting a +2 item bonus to attack rolls and increasing the number of weapon damage dice by two). Berserker's Cloak **Source** [Player Core 2](/Sources.aspx?ID=227) pg. 310, [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 606 **Price** 2,000 gp **Bulk** 1 Berserker's Cloak (Greater) **Source** [Player Core 2](/Sources.aspx?ID=227) pg. 310, [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 606 **Price** 40,000 gp **Bulk** 1 --- You gain the benefits of a _+2 weapon potency_ rune and a _greater striking rune_, or a _+3 weapon potency_ rune and a _major striking_ rune if you have an animal instinct and the bestial rage instinct ability.

fields.text: Item 12+ Berserker's Cloak Invested Primal Source Player Core 2 pg. 310 Usage worn cloak Bulk 1 This bearskin includes the head and bared teeth of the mighty creature from which it was taken. When worn, the cloak drapes over your head and around your shoulders, imbuing you with a bear's ferocity. If you have the Rage action, while raging, you grow jaws that deal 1d10 piercing damage and claws that deal 1d6 slashing damage and have the agile trait. This transformation is a morph effect, and both the jaws and claws are unarmed attacks in the brawling weapon group. You gain the benefits of a +1 weapon potency rune and a striking rune with these attacks (gaining a +1 item bonus to attack rolls and increasing the number of weapon damage dice by one). If you have an animal instinct and the bestial rage instinct ability, instead of gaining these unarmed attacks, your unarmed attacks from the bestial rage instinct ability gain the benefits of a +2 weapon potency rune and a greater striking rune (granting a +2 item bonus to attack rolls and increasing the number of weapon damage dice by two). Item 12 Berserker's Cloak Source Player Core 2 pg. 310, Core Rulebook pg. 606 Price 2,000 gp Bulk 1 Item 19 Berserker's Cloak (Greater) Source Player Core 2 pg. 310, Core Rulebook pg. 606 Price 40,000 gp Bulk 1 You gain the benefits of a +2 weapon potency rune and a greater striking rune , or a +3 weapon potency rune and a major striking rune if you have an animal instinct and the bestial rage instinct ability.

**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 606

**Usage** worn cloak

</row>

<row gap="medium">

</column>

---

This bearskin includes the head and bared teeth of the mighty creature from which it was taken. When worn, the cloak drapes over your head and around your shoulders, imbuing you with a bear’s ferocity. If you have the Rage action, while raging you grow jaws that deal 1d10 piercing damage and claws that deal 1d6 slashing damage and have the agile trait. This transformation is a morph effect, and both the jaws and claws are unarmed attacks in the brawling weapon group. You gain the benefits of a _+1 weapon potency_ rune and a _striking_ rune with these attacks (gaining a +1 item bonus to attack rolls and increasing the weapon damage dice by one).

 If you have an [animal instinct](/Instincts.aspx?ID=1) and the bestial rage instinct ability, instead of gaining these unarmed attacks, your unarmed attacks from the bestial rage instinct ability gain the benefits of a _+2 weapon potency_ rune and a _greater striking_ rune (granting a +2 item bonus to attack rolls and increasing the weapon damage dice by two).

**Craft Requirements** You are a barbarian with the animal instinct.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

Your features transform into something bestial and lumbering. 

**Benefit** You gain an item bonus to [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=36) checks and unarmed attack rolls. You gain a claw unarmed attack with the agile trait and a jaws unarmed attack. Striking runes don't modify the damage caused by these attacks. 

**Drawback** You take a –2 penalty to Reflex saves, [Acrobatics](/Skills.aspx?ID=34) checks, and [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=48) checks.

</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Grimoire" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=387" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Impossible Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=355) pg. 228

**Price** 210 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This grimoire fancifully illustrates the spells you inscribe within it with illuminated drawings of creatures that have never existed, the pictures changing to depict new ones from time to time. 

**Activate—Shifting Form** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [polymorph](/Traits.aspx?ID=670)) **Frequency** once per day;  **Requirements** You’re under the effect of a polymorph spell that offers a choice of multiple forms; **Effect** You transform into a different form allowed by the polymorph by bending and molding the spell’s energy. This reduces the spell’s remaining duration by half.

Whispers of gibberish arise from it, making their way to nearby ears despite any other sounds in the area. You Activate the spellgun by aiming it at one creature and making your choice of a spell attack roll or a firearm attack roll against the target's AC. This spellgun has a [range increment](/Traits.aspx?ID=248) of 15 feet. Once fired, the spellgun twists in your hand and melts away. **Critical Success** The target is [confused](/Conditions.aspx?ID=5) for 1 minute.
**Success** The target is confused for 1 minute but can attempt a DC 25 Will save at the end of each of its turns to end the effect.

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 119

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** tattooed on the body

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

While dormant, this tattoo appears to be a simple flower bud, but when activated the flower swiftly blossoms, remaining that way until the next time you make your daily preparations. These blooms are colorful, elegant representations of distinct flower species, as determined by its type.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** Choose a willing ally you can see within 30 feet. The ally fills with an emotion themed to the flower and gains the benefit listed for the type of _bewitching bloom_ you have.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

<title
level="2"
right="Item 15"
pfs="Standard"
>
Bewitching Bloom (Amaranth)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 119

**Price** 5,500 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

The ally feels impervious, immortal. The next time they would take damage from a hazard, an enemy's attack, or an effect created by an enemy, that damage can't reduce the ally below 1 HP. This benefit ends if unused before the start of your next turn.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 7"
pfs="Standard"
>
Bewitching Bloom (Bellflower)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 119

**Price** 350 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

A need for freedom trills through your ally's blood. Until the end of that ally's next turn, they gain a +2 status bonus to rolls to recover from the [confused](/Conditions.aspx?ID=5), [frightened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=19), [grabbed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=20), [paralyzed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=28), and [restrained](/Conditions.aspx?ID=33) conditions. When you Activate the bloom, the target can attempt a new save against a condition the bonus applies to, or they can use a reaction to attempt to [Escape](/Actions.aspx?ID=79) being grabbed, [immobilized](/Conditions.aspx?ID=24), or restrained, provided such an attempt is allowed.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 3"
pfs="Standard"
>
Bewitching Bloom (Cherry Blossom)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 119

**Price** 50 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

The ally understands the fleeting nature of life and accepts fate. For 1 minute, any recovery checks the ally attempts have a DC of 10 instead of 10 + the ally's [dying](/Conditions.aspx?ID=11) value. The cherry blossom's activation can target an [unconscious](/Conditions.aspx?ID=38) or dying ally.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 2"
pfs="Standard"
>
Bewitching Bloom (Lilac)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 119

**Price** 25 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

Memories bubble to the surface of your ally's mind. The ally attempts to [Recall Knowledge](/Actions.aspx?ID=26) with a +2 status bonus to the check from these vibrant memories.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 9"
pfs="Standard"
>
Bewitching Bloom (Lotus)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 119

**Price** 600 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

A glow envelops your ally as a sense of enlightened peace ripples out from within. The ally gains a +2 status bonus to Will saves against [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106) effects for 1 minute. This bonus increases to +3 against [emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=60) effects.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 6"
pfs="Standard"
>
Bewitching Bloom (Magnolia)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 119

**Price** 220 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

Your ally seems more charming, though no one can pinpoint why. They gain a +1 status bonus to [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) checks for 10 minutes. Once on their next turn, the ally can attempt to draw a creature's attention. To do so, the ally must spend 1 action (which has the [emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=60), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106), and [visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=163) traits) to select a creature the ally can see and make eye contact in a way the target can see. The target must succeed at a DC 20 Will save or be [fascinated](/Conditions.aspx?ID=14) with your ally until the end of that ally's next turn. If the save succeeds or the effect ends, the target is temporarily immune to being fascinated by any _magnolia bewitching bloom_ for 24 hours.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 11"
pfs="Standard"
>
Bewitching Bloom (Purple Iris)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 119

**Price** 1,200 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

Your ally takes on a regal bearing, exuding the presence of confident royalty. The bloom casts a 5th-rank [_command_](/Spells.aspx?ID=45) spell (DC 28) selecting targets within range of the ally. Each target that fails the save must fall [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=31) and pays homage to your ally.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 4"
pfs="Standard"
>
Bewitching Bloom (Red Rose)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 119

**Price** 90 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

The ally fills with feelings of love. They chooses a creature that the ally has strong positive emotions toward as beloved. While the ally is within 10 feet of this beloved, the ally gains a +1 status bonus to saving throws. If the ally starts their turn within 10 feet of the beloved, the ally gains 5 temporary Hit Points. These benefits last for 1 minute, and temporary HP remaining from this effect at the end of that time disappear. This effect has the [emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=60) and [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106) traits.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 4"
pfs="Standard"
>
Bewitching Bloom (White Poppy)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 119

**Price** 80 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

A sense of peace overwhelms the ally. The tattoo casts [_calm_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1458) or [_sanctuary_](/Spells.aspx?ID=266) (your choice) on the ally. The spell affects only the ally and lasts only until the end of your next turn. Your ally need not be willing if under the [control](/Conditions.aspx?ID=6) of another creature. However, the controlling creature can attempt a DC 20 Will save, disrupting your activation on a success.

>
Bewitching Bloom (Bellflower)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 119

**Price** 350 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

A need for freedom trills through your ally's blood. Until the end of that ally's next turn, they gain a +2 status bonus to rolls to recover from the [confused](/Conditions.aspx?ID=5), [frightened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=19), [grabbed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=20), [paralyzed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=28), and [restrained](/Conditions.aspx?ID=33) conditions. When you Activate the bloom, the target can attempt a new save against a condition the bonus applies to, or they can use a reaction to attempt to [Escape](/Actions.aspx?ID=79) being grabbed, [immobilized](/Conditions.aspx?ID=24), or restrained, provided such an attempt is allowed.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 3"
pfs="Standard"
>
Bewitching Bloom (Cherry Blossom)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 119

**Price** 50 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

The ally understands the fleeting nature of life and accepts fate. For 1 minute, any recovery checks the ally attempts have a DC of 10 instead of 10 + the ally's [dying](/Conditions.aspx?ID=11) value. The cherry blossom's activation can target an [unconscious](/Conditions.aspx?ID=38) or dying ally.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 2"
pfs="Standard"
>
Bewitching Bloom (Lilac)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 119

**Price** 25 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

Memories bubble to the surface of your ally's mind. The ally attempts to [Recall Knowledge](/Actions.aspx?ID=26) with a +2 status bonus to the check from these vibrant memories.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 9"
pfs="Standard"
>
Bewitching Bloom (Lotus)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 119

**Price** 600 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

A glow envelops your ally as a sense of enlightened peace ripples out from within. The ally gains a +2 status bonus to Will saves against [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106) effects for 1 minute. This bonus increases to +3 against [emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=60) effects.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 6"
pfs="Standard"
>
Bewitching Bloom (Magnolia)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 119

**Price** 220 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

Your ally seems more charming, though no one can pinpoint why. They gain a +1 status bonus to [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) checks for 10 minutes. Once on their next turn, the ally can attempt to draw a creature's attention. To do so, the ally must spend 1 action (which has the [emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=60), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106), and [visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=163) traits) to select a creature the ally can see and make eye contact in a way the target can see. The target must succeed at a DC 20 Will save or be [fascinated](/Conditions.aspx?ID=14) with your ally until the end of that ally's next turn. If the save succeeds or the effect ends, the target is temporarily immune to being fascinated by any _magnolia bewitching bloom_ for 24 hours.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 11"
pfs="Standard"
>
Bewitching Bloom (Purple Iris)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 119

**Price** 1,200 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

Your ally takes on a regal bearing, exuding the presence of confident royalty. The bloom casts a 5th-rank [_command_](/Spells.aspx?ID=45) spell (DC 28) selecting targets within range of the ally. Each target that fails the save must fall [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=31) and pays homage to your ally.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 4"
pfs="Standard"
>
Bewitching Bloom (Red Rose)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 119

**Price** 90 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

The ally fills with feelings of love. They chooses a creature that the ally has strong positive emotions toward as beloved. While the ally is within 10 feet of this beloved, the ally gains a +1 status bonus to saving throws. If the ally starts their turn within 10 feet of the beloved, the ally gains 5 temporary Hit Points. These benefits last for 1 minute, and temporary HP remaining from this effect at the end of that time disappear. This effect has the [emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=60) and [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106) traits.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 4"
pfs="Standard"
>
Bewitching Bloom (White Poppy)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 119

**Price** 80 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

A sense of peace overwhelms the ally. The tattoo casts [_calm_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1458) or [_sanctuary_](/Spells.aspx?ID=266) (your choice) on the ally. The spell affects only the ally and lasts only until the end of your next turn. Your ally need not be willing if under the [control](/Conditions.aspx?ID=6) of another creature. However, the controlling creature can attempt a DC 20 Will save, disrupting your activation on a success.

For 1 minute, any recovery checks the ally attempts have a DC of 10 instead of 10 + the ally's [dying](/Conditions.aspx?ID=11) value. The cherry blossom's activation can target an [unconscious](/Conditions.aspx?ID=38) or dying ally.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 2"
pfs="Standard"
>
Bewitching Bloom (Lilac)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 119

**Price** 25 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

Memories bubble to the surface of your ally's mind. The ally attempts to [Recall Knowledge](/Actions.aspx?ID=26) with a +2 status bonus to the check from these vibrant memories.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 9"
pfs="Standard"
>
Bewitching Bloom (Lotus)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 119

**Price** 600 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

A glow envelops your ally as a sense of enlightened peace ripples out from within. The ally gains a +2 status bonus to Will saves against [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106) effects for 1 minute. This bonus increases to +3 against [emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=60) effects.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 6"
pfs="Standard"
>
Bewitching Bloom (Magnolia)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 119

**Price** 220 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

Your ally seems more charming, though no one can pinpoint why. They gain a +1 status bonus to [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) checks for 10 minutes. Once on their next turn, the ally can attempt to draw a creature's attention. To do so, the ally must spend 1 action (which has the [emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=60), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106), and [visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=163) traits) to select a creature the ally can see and make eye contact in a way the target can see. The target must succeed at a DC 20 Will save or be [fascinated](/Conditions.aspx?ID=14) with your ally until the end of that ally's next turn. If the save succeeds or the effect ends, the target is temporarily immune to being fascinated by any _magnolia bewitching bloom_ for 24 hours.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 11"
pfs="Standard"
>
Bewitching Bloom (Purple Iris)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 119

**Price** 1,200 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

Your ally takes on a regal bearing, exuding the presence of confident royalty. The bloom casts a 5th-rank [_command_](/Spells.aspx?ID=45) spell (DC 28) selecting targets within range of the ally. Each target that fails the save must fall [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=31) and pays homage to your ally.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 4"
pfs="Standard"
>
Bewitching Bloom (Red Rose)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 119

**Price** 90 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

The ally fills with feelings of love. They chooses a creature that the ally has strong positive emotions toward as beloved. While the ally is within 10 feet of this beloved, the ally gains a +1 status bonus to saving throws. If the ally starts their turn within 10 feet of the beloved, the ally gains 5 temporary Hit Points. These benefits last for 1 minute, and temporary HP remaining from this effect at the end of that time disappear. This effect has the [emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=60) and [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106) traits.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 4"
pfs="Standard"
>
Bewitching Bloom (White Poppy)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 119

**Price** 80 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

A sense of peace overwhelms the ally. The tattoo casts [_calm_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1458) or [_sanctuary_](/Spells.aspx?ID=266) (your choice) on the ally. The spell affects only the ally and lasts only until the end of your next turn. Your ally need not be willing if under the [control](/Conditions.aspx?ID=6) of another creature. However, the controlling creature can attempt a DC 20 Will save, disrupting your activation on a success.

A glow envelops your ally as a sense of enlightened peace ripples out from within. The ally gains a +2 status bonus to Will saves against [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106) effects for 1 minute. This bonus increases to +3 against [emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=60) effects.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 6"
pfs="Standard"
>
Bewitching Bloom (Magnolia)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 119

**Price** 220 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

Your ally seems more charming, though no one can pinpoint why. They gain a +1 status bonus to [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=6) checks for 10 minutes. Once on their next turn, the ally can attempt to draw a creature's attention. To do so, the ally must spend 1 action (which has the [emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=60), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106), and [visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=163) traits) to select a creature the ally can see and make eye contact in a way the target can see. The target must succeed at a DC 20 Will save or be [fascinated](/Conditions.aspx?ID=14) with your ally until the end of that ally's next turn. If the save succeeds or the effect ends, the target is temporarily immune to being fascinated by any _magnolia bewitching bloom_ for 24 hours.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 11"
pfs="Standard"
>

<traits>

</traits>

Your ally takes on a regal bearing, exuding the presence of confident royalty. The bloom casts a 5th-rank [_command_](/Spells.aspx?ID=45) spell (DC 28) selecting targets within range of the ally. Each target that fails the save must fall [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=31) and pays homage to your ally.

level="2"
right="Item 4"
pfs="Standard"

</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

The ally fills with feelings of love. They chooses a creature that the ally has strong positive emotions toward as beloved. While the ally is within 10 feet of this beloved, the ally gains a +1 status bonus to saving throws. If the ally starts their turn within 10 feet of the beloved, the ally gains 5 temporary Hit Points. These benefits last for 1 minute, and temporary HP remaining from this effect at the end of that time disappear. This effect has the [emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=60) and [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=106) traits.

</traits>

fields.text: Item 2+ Bewitching Bloom Enchantment Invested Magical Tattoo Source Treasure Vault (Remastered) pg. 119 Usage tattooed on the body While dormant, this tattoo appears to be a simple flower bud, but when activated the flower swiftly blossoms, remaining that way until the next time you make your daily preparations. These blooms are colorful, elegant representations of distinct flower species, as determined by its type. Activate Two Actions (concentrate) Frequency once per day; Effect Choose a willing ally you can see within 30 feet. The ally fills with an emotion themed to the flower and gains the benefit listed for the type of bewitching bloom you have. Item 15 Bewitching Bloom (Amaranth) Source Treasure Vault (Remastered) pg. 119 Price 5,500 gp The ally feels impervious, immortal. The next time they would take damage from a hazard, an enemy's attack, or an effect created by an enemy, that damage can't reduce the ally below 1 HP. This benefit ends if unused before the start of your next turn. Item 7 Bewitching Bloom (Bellflower) Source Treasure Vault (Remastered) pg. 119 Price 350 gp A need for freedom trills through your ally's blood. Until the end of that ally's next turn, they gain a +2 status bonus to rolls to recover from the confused, frightened, grabbed, paralyzed, and restrained conditions. When you Activate the bloom, the target can attempt a new save against a condition the bonus applies to, or they can use a reaction to attempt to Escape being grabbed, immobilized, or restrained, provided such an attempt is allowed. Item 3 Bewitching Bloom (Cherry Blossom) Source Treasure Vault (Remastered) pg. 119 Price 50 gp The ally understands the fleeting nature of life and accepts fate. For 1 minute, any recovery checks the ally attempts have a DC of 10 instead of 10 + the ally's dying value. The cherry blossom's activation can target an unconscious or dying ally. Item 2 Bewitching Bloom (Lilac) Source Treasure Vault (Remastered) pg. 119 Price 25 gp Memories bubble to the surface of your ally's mind. The ally attempts to Recall Knowledge with a +2 status bonus to the check from these vibrant memories. Item 9 Bewitching Bloom (Lotus) Source Treasure Vault (Remastered) pg. 119 Price 600 gp A glow envelops your ally as a sense of enlightened peace ripples out from within. The ally gains a +2 status bonus to Will saves against mental effects for 1 minute. This bonus increases to +3 against emotion effects. Item 6 Bewitching Bloom (Magnolia) Source Treasure Vault (Remastered) pg. 119 Price 220 gp Your ally seems more charming, though no one can pinpoint why. They gain a +1 status bonus to Diplomacy checks for 10 minutes. Once on their next turn, the ally can attempt to draw a creature's attention. To do so, the ally must spend 1 action (which has the emotion, mental, and visual traits) to select a creature the ally can see and make eye contact in a way the target can see. The target must succeed at a DC 20 Will save or be fascinated with your ally until the end of that ally's next turn. If the save succeeds or the effect ends, the target is temporarily immune to being fascinated by any magnolia bewitching bloom for 24 hours. Item 11 Bewitching Bloom (Purple Iris) Source Treasure Vault (Remastered) pg. 119 Price 1,200 gp Your ally takes on a regal bearing, exuding the presence of confident royalty. The bloom casts a 5th-rank command spell (DC 28) selecting targets within range of the ally. Each target that fails the save must fall prone and pays homage to your ally. Item 4 Bewitching Bloom (Red Rose) Source Treasure Vault (Remastered) pg. 119 Price 90 gp The ally fills with feelings of love. They chooses a creature that the ally has strong positive emotions toward as beloved. While the ally is within 10 feet of this beloved, the ally gains a +1 status bonus to saving throws. If the ally starts their turn within 10 feet of the beloved, the ally gains 5 temporary Hit Points. These benefits last for 1 minute, and temporary HP remaining from this effect at the end of that time disappear. This effect has the emotion and mental traits. Item 4 Bewitching Bloom (White Poppy) Source Treasure Vault (Remastered) pg. 119 Price 80 gp A sense of peace overwhelms the ally. The tattoo casts calm or sanctuary (your choice) on the ally. The spell affects only the ally and lasts only until the end of your next turn. Your ally need not be willing if under the control of another creature. However, the controlling creature can attempt a DC 20 Will save, disrupting your activation on a success.

While dormant, this tattoo appears to be a simple flower bud, but when activated the flower swiftly blossoms, remaining that way until the next time you make your daily preparations. These blooms are colorful, elegant representations of distinct flower species, as determined by its type.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> envision;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** Choose a willing ally you can see within 30 feet. The ally fills with an emotion themed to the flower and gains the benefit listed for the type of bewitching bloom you have.

<column gap="tiny">

The ally feels impervious, immortal. The next time they would take damage from a hazard, an enemy’s attack, or an effect created by an enemy, that damage can’t reduce the ally below 1 HP. This benefit ends if unused before the start of your next turn.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 7"
pfs="Standard"
>

</title>

<traits>

**Price** 350 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

A need for freedom trills through your ally’s blood. Until the end of that ally’s next turn, they gain a +2 status bonus to rolls to recover from the [confused](/Conditions.aspx?ID=63), [frightened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=76), [grabbed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=77), [paralyzed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=85), and [restrained](/Conditions.aspx?ID=90) conditions. When you Activate the bloom, the target can attempt a new save against a condition the bonus applies to, or they can use a reaction to attempt to [Escape](/Actions.aspx?ID=2296) being grabbed, [immobilized](/Conditions.aspx?ID=81), or restrained, provided such an attempt is allowed.

The ally understands the fleeting nature of life and accepts fate. For 1 minute, any [recovery checks](/Rules.aspx?ID=2326) the ally attempts have a DC of 10 instead of 10 + the ally’s [dying](/Conditions.aspx?ID=69) value. The cherry blossom’s activation can target an [unconscious](/Conditions.aspx?ID=95) or dying ally.

If the save succeeds or the effect ends, the target is temporarily immune to being fascinated by any magnolia bewitching bloom for 24 hours.

fields.text: Item 2+ Bewitching Bloom Enchantment Invested Magical Tattoo Source Treasure Vault (Remastered) pg. 119 Usage tattooed on the body While dormant, this tattoo appears to be a simple flower bud, but when activated the flower swiftly blossoms, remaining that way until the next time you make your daily preparations. These blooms are colorful, elegant representations of distinct flower species, as determined by its type. Activate Two Actions (concentrate) Frequency once per day; Effect Choose a willing ally you can see within 30 feet. The ally fills with an emotion themed to the flower and gains the benefit listed for the type of bewitching bloom you have. Item 15 Bewitching Bloom (Amaranth) Source Treasure Vault (Remastered) pg. 119 Price 5,500 gp The ally feels impervious, immortal. The next time they would take damage from a hazard, an enemy's attack, or an effect created by an enemy, that damage can't reduce the ally below 1 HP. This benefit ends if unused before the start of your next turn. Item 7 Bewitching Bloom (Bellflower) Source Treasure Vault (Remastered) pg. 119 Price 350 gp A need for freedom trills through your ally's blood. Until the end of that ally's next turn, they gain a +2 status bonus to rolls to recover from the confused, frightened, grabbed, paralyzed, and restrained conditions. When you Activate the bloom, the target can attempt a new save against a condition the bonus applies to, or they can use a reaction to attempt to Escape being grabbed, immobilized, or restrained, provided such an attempt is allowed. Item 3 Bewitching Bloom (Cherry Blossom) Source Treasure Vault (Remastered) pg. 119 Price 50 gp The ally understands the fleeting nature of life and accepts fate. For 1 minute, any recovery checks the ally attempts have a DC of 10 instead of 10 + the ally's dying value. The cherry blossom's activation can target an unconscious or dying ally. Item 2 Bewitching Bloom (Lilac) Source Treasure Vault (Remastered) pg. 119 Price 25 gp Memories bubble to the surface of your ally's mind. The ally attempts to Recall Knowledge with a +2 status bonus to the check from these vibrant memories. Item 9 Bewitching Bloom (Lotus) Source Treasure Vault (Remastered) pg. 119 Price 600 gp A glow envelops your ally as a sense of enlightened peace ripples out from within. The ally gains a +2 status bonus to Will saves against mental effects for 1 minute. This bonus increases to +3 against emotion effects. Item 6 Bewitching Bloom (Magnolia) Source Treasure Vault (Remastered) pg. 119 Price 220 gp Your ally seems more charming, though no one can pinpoint why. They gain a +1 status bonus to Diplomacy checks for 10 minutes. Once on their next turn, the ally can attempt to draw a creature's attention. To do so, the ally must spend 1 action (which has the emotion, mental, and visual traits) to select a creature the ally can see and make eye contact in a way the target can see. The target must succeed at a DC 20 Will save or be fascinated with your ally until the end of that ally's next turn. If the save succeeds or the effect ends, the target is temporarily immune to being fascinated by any magnolia bewitching bloom for 24 hours. Item 11 Bewitching Bloom (Purple Iris) Source Treasure Vault (Remastered) pg. 119 Price 1,200 gp Your ally takes on a regal bearing, exuding the presence of confident royalty. The bloom casts a 5th-rank command spell (DC 28) selecting targets within range of the ally. Each target that fails the save must fall prone and pays homage to your ally. Item 4 Bewitching Bloom (Red Rose) Source Treasure Vault (Remastered) pg. 119 Price 90 gp The ally fills with feelings of love. They chooses a creature that the ally has strong positive emotions toward as beloved. While the ally is within 10 feet of this beloved, the ally gains a +1 status bonus to saving throws. If the ally starts their turn within 10 feet of the beloved, the ally gains 5 temporary Hit Points. These benefits last for 1 minute, and temporary HP remaining from this effect at the end of that time disappear. This effect has the emotion and mental traits. Item 4 Bewitching Bloom (White Poppy) Source Treasure Vault (Remastered) pg. 119 Price 80 gp A sense of peace overwhelms the ally. The tattoo casts calm or sanctuary (your choice) on the ally. The spell affects only the ally and lasts only until the end of your next turn. Your ally need not be willing if under the control of another creature. However, the controlling creature can attempt a DC 20 Will save, disrupting your activation on a success.

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 2+"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Bewitching Bloom](/Equipment.aspx?ID=4737)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Enchantment" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=61" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Tattoo" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=262" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=320) pg. 119

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** tattooed on the body

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

While dormant, this tattoo appears to be a simple flower bud, but when activated the flower swiftly blossoms, remaining that way until the next time you make your daily preparations. These blooms are colorful, elegant representations of distinct flower species, as determined by its type.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> envision;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** Choose a willing ally you can see within 30 feet. The ally fills with an emotion themed to the flower and gains the benefit listed for the type of bewitching bloom you have.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

<title
level="2"
right="Item 15"
pfs="Standard"
>
Bewitching Bloom (Amaranth)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=320) pg. 119

**Price** 5,500 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

The ally feels impervious, immortal. The next time they would take damage from a hazard, an enemy’s attack, or an effect created by an enemy, that damage can’t reduce the ally below 1 HP. This benefit ends if unused before the start of your next turn.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 7"
pfs="Standard"
>
Bewitching Bloom (Bellflower)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=320) pg. 119

**Price** 350 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

A need for freedom trills through your ally’s blood. Until the end of that ally’s next turn, they gain a +2 status bonus to rolls to recover from the [confused](/Conditions.aspx?ID=63), [frightened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=76), [grabbed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=77), [paralyzed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=85), and [restrained](/Conditions.aspx?ID=90) conditions. When you Activate the bloom, the target can attempt a new save against a condition the bonus applies to, or they can use a reaction to attempt to [Escape](/Actions.aspx?ID=2296) being grabbed, [immobilized](/Conditions.aspx?ID=81), or restrained, provided such an attempt is allowed.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 3"
pfs="Standard"
>
Bewitching Bloom (Cherry Blossom)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=320) pg. 119

**Price** 50 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

The ally understands the fleeting nature of life and accepts fate. For 1 minute, any [recovery checks](/Rules.aspx?ID=2326) the ally attempts have a DC of 10 instead of 10 + the ally’s [dying](/Conditions.aspx?ID=69) value. The cherry blossom’s activation can target an [unconscious](/Conditions.aspx?ID=95) or dying ally.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 2"
pfs="Standard"
>
Bewitching Bloom (Lilac)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=320) pg. 119

**Price** 25 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

Memories bubble to the surface of your ally’s mind. The ally attempts to Recall Knowledge with a +2 status bonus to the check from these vibrant memories.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 9"
pfs="Standard"
>
Bewitching Bloom (Lotus)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=320) pg. 119

**Price** 600 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

A glow envelops your ally as a sense of enlightened peace ripples out from within. The ally gains a +2 status bonus to Will saves against [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647) effects for 1 minute. This bonus increases to +3 against [emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=590) effects.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 6"
pfs="Standard"
>
Bewitching Bloom (Magnolia)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=320) pg. 119

**Price** 220 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

Your ally seems more charming, though no one can pinpoint why. They gain a +1 status bonus to [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=39) checks for 10 minutes. Once on their next turn, the ally can attempt to draw a creature’s attention. To do so, the ally must spend 1 action (which has the [emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=590), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647), and [visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=727) traits) to select a creature the ally can see and make eye contact in a way the target can see. The target must succeed at a DC 20 Will save or be [fascinated](/Conditions.aspx?ID=72) with your ally until the end of that ally’s next turn. If the save succeeds or the effect ends, the target is temporarily immune to being fascinated by any magnolia bewitching bloom for 24 hours.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 11"
pfs="Standard"
>
Bewitching Bloom (Purple Iris)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=320) pg. 119

**Price** 1,200 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

Your ally takes on a regal bearing, exuding the presence of confident royalty. The bloom casts a 5th-level [_command_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1470) spell (DC 28) selecting targets within range of the ally. Each target that fails the save must fall [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=88) and pays homage to your ally.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 4"
pfs="Standard"
>
Bewitching Bloom (Red Rose)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=320) pg. 119

**Price** 90 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

The ally fills with feelings of love. They chooses a creature that the ally has strong positive emotions toward as beloved. While the ally is within 10 feet of this beloved, the ally gains a +1 status bonus to saving throws. If the ally starts their turn within 10 feet of the beloved, the ally gains 5 [temporary Hit Points](/Rules.aspx?ID=2321). These benefits last for 1 minute, and temporary HP remaining from this effect at the end of that time disappear. This effect has the [emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=590) and [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647) traits.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 4"
pfs="Standard"
>
Bewitching Bloom (White Poppy)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=320) pg. 119

_[**PFS Note**](/pathfinder-society) The _white poppy bewitching bloom tattoo_ (page 119) uses [_calm_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1458), not [_calm emotions_](/Spells.aspx?ID=31)._

**Price** 80 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

A sense of peace overwhelms the ally. The tattoo casts [_calm emotions_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1458) or [_sanctuary_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1660) (your choice) on the ally. The spell affects only the ally and lasts only until the end of your next turn. Your ally need not be willing if under the control of another creature. However, the controlling creature can attempt a DC 20 Will save, disrupting your activation on a success.

<traits>

<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=320) pg. 119

**Usage** tattooed on the body

<row gap="medium">

While dormant, this tattoo appears to be a simple flower bud, but when activated the flower swiftly blossoms, remaining that way until the next time you make your daily preparations. These blooms are colorful, elegant representations of distinct flower species, as determined by its type.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> envision;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** Choose a willing ally you can see within 30 feet. The ally fills with an emotion themed to the flower and gains the benefit listed for the type of bewitching bloom you have.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

level="2"

</traits>

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

The ally feels impervious, immortal. The next time they would take damage from a hazard, an enemy’s attack, or an effect created by an enemy, that damage can’t reduce the ally below 1 HP. This benefit ends if unused before the start of your next turn.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 7"
pfs="Standard"
>

</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Price** 350 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

A need for freedom trills through your ally’s blood. Until the end of that ally’s next turn, they gain a +2 status bonus to rolls to recover from the [confused](/Conditions.aspx?ID=63), [frightened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=76), [grabbed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=77), [paralyzed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=85), and [restrained](/Conditions.aspx?ID=90) conditions. When you Activate the bloom, the target can attempt a new save against a condition the bonus applies to, or they can use a reaction to attempt to [Escape](/Actions.aspx?ID=2296) being grabbed, [immobilized](/Conditions.aspx?ID=81), or restrained, provided such an attempt is allowed.

level="2"
right="Item 3"
pfs="Standard"

</title>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=320) pg. 119

**Price** 50 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

The ally understands the fleeting nature of life and accepts fate. For 1 minute, any [recovery checks](/Rules.aspx?ID=2326) the ally attempts have a DC of 10 instead of 10 + the ally’s [dying](/Conditions.aspx?ID=69) value. The cherry blossom’s activation can target an [unconscious](/Conditions.aspx?ID=95) or dying ally.

<title
level="2"

Once on their next turn, the ally can attempt to draw a creature’s attention. **Usage** tattooed on the body

<row gap="medium">

While dormant, this tattoo appears to be a simple flower bud, but when activated the flower swiftly blossoms, remaining that way until the next time you make your daily preparations. These blooms are colorful, elegant representations of distinct flower species, as determined by its type.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> envision;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** Choose a willing ally you can see within 30 feet. The ally fills with an emotion themed to the flower and gains the benefit listed for the type of bewitching bloom you have.

<column gap="tiny">

level="2"
right="Item 15"
pfs="Standard"

<traits>

</traits>

<row gap="medium">

</row>

The ally feels impervious, immortal. The next time they would take damage from a hazard, an enemy’s attack, or an effect created by an enemy, that damage can’t reduce the ally below 1 HP. This benefit ends if unused before the start of your next turn.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 7"
pfs="Standard"
>

</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<row gap="medium">

</row>

<row gap="medium">

</row>

Item 4 Bewitching Bloom (White Poppy) Source Treasure Vault (Remastered) pg. 119 Price 80 gp A sense of peace overwhelms the ally. The tattoo casts calm or sanctuary (your choice) on the ally. The spell affects only the ally and lasts only until the end of your next turn. Your ally need not be willing if under the control of another creature. However, the controlling creature can attempt a DC 20 Will save, disrupting your activation on a success.

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 2+"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Bewitching Bloom](/Equipment.aspx?ID=4737)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Enchantment" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=61" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Tattoo" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=262" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=320) pg. 119

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** tattooed on the body

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

While dormant, this tattoo appears to be a simple flower bud, but when activated the flower swiftly blossoms, remaining that way until the next time you make your daily preparations. These blooms are colorful, elegant representations of distinct flower species, as determined by its type.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> envision;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** Choose a willing ally you can see within 30 feet. The ally fills with an emotion themed to the flower and gains the benefit listed for the type of bewitching bloom you have.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

<title
level="2"
right="Item 15"
pfs="Standard"
>
Bewitching Bloom (Amaranth)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=320) pg. 119

**Price** 5,500 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

The ally feels impervious, immortal. The next time they would take damage from a hazard, an enemy’s attack, or an effect created by an enemy, that damage can’t reduce the ally below 1 HP. This benefit ends if unused before the start of your next turn.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 7"
pfs="Standard"
>
Bewitching Bloom (Bellflower)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=320) pg. 119

**Price** 350 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

A need for freedom trills through your ally’s blood. Until the end of that ally’s next turn, they gain a +2 status bonus to rolls to recover from the [confused](/Conditions.aspx?ID=63), [frightened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=76), [grabbed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=77), [paralyzed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=85), and [restrained](/Conditions.aspx?ID=90) conditions. When you Activate the bloom, the target can attempt a new save against a condition the bonus applies to, or they can use a reaction to attempt to [Escape](/Actions.aspx?ID=2296) being grabbed, [immobilized](/Conditions.aspx?ID=81), or restrained, provided such an attempt is allowed.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 3"
pfs="Standard"
>
Bewitching Bloom (Cherry Blossom)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=320) pg. 119

**Price** 50 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

The ally understands the fleeting nature of life and accepts fate. For 1 minute, any [recovery checks](/Rules.aspx?ID=2326) the ally attempts have a DC of 10 instead of 10 + the ally’s [dying](/Conditions.aspx?ID=69) value. The cherry blossom’s activation can target an [unconscious](/Conditions.aspx?ID=95) or dying ally.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 2"
pfs="Standard"
>
Bewitching Bloom (Lilac)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=320) pg. 119

**Price** 25 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

Memories bubble to the surface of your ally’s mind. The ally attempts to Recall Knowledge with a +2 status bonus to the check from these vibrant memories.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 9"
pfs="Standard"
>
Bewitching Bloom (Lotus)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=320) pg. 119

**Price** 600 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

A glow envelops your ally as a sense of enlightened peace ripples out from within. The ally gains a +2 status bonus to Will saves against [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647) effects for 1 minute. This bonus increases to +3 against [emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=590) effects.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 6"
pfs="Standard"
>
Bewitching Bloom (Magnolia)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=320) pg. 119

**Price** 220 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

Your ally seems more charming, though no one can pinpoint why. They gain a +1 status bonus to [Diplomacy](/Skills.aspx?ID=39) checks for 10 minutes. Once on their next turn, the ally can attempt to draw a creature’s attention. To do so, the ally must spend 1 action (which has the [emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=590), [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647), and [visual](/Traits.aspx?ID=727) traits) to select a creature the ally can see and make eye contact in a way the target can see. The target must succeed at a DC 20 Will save or be [fascinated](/Conditions.aspx?ID=72) with your ally until the end of that ally’s next turn. If the save succeeds or the effect ends, the target is temporarily immune to being fascinated by any magnolia bewitching bloom for 24 hours.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 11"
pfs="Standard"
>
Bewitching Bloom (Purple Iris)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=320) pg. 119

**Price** 1,200 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

Your ally takes on a regal bearing, exuding the presence of confident royalty. The bloom casts a 5th-level [_command_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1470) spell (DC 28) selecting targets within range of the ally. Each target that fails the save must fall [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=88) and pays homage to your ally.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 4"
pfs="Standard"
>
Bewitching Bloom (Red Rose)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=320) pg. 119

**Price** 90 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

The ally fills with feelings of love. They chooses a creature that the ally has strong positive emotions toward as beloved. While the ally is within 10 feet of this beloved, the ally gains a +1 status bonus to saving throws. If the ally starts their turn within 10 feet of the beloved, the ally gains 5 [temporary Hit Points](/Rules.aspx?ID=2321). These benefits last for 1 minute, and temporary HP remaining from this effect at the end of that time disappear. This effect has the [emotion](/Traits.aspx?ID=590) and [mental](/Traits.aspx?ID=647) traits.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 4"
pfs="Standard"
>
Bewitching Bloom (White Poppy)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault](/Sources.aspx?ID=320) pg. 119

_[**PFS Note**](/pathfinder-society) The _white poppy bewitching bloom tattoo_ (page 119) uses [_calm_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1458), not [_calm emotions_](/Spells.aspx?ID=31)._

**Price** 80 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

A sense of peace overwhelms the ally. The tattoo casts [_calm emotions_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1458) or [_sanctuary_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1660) (your choice) on the ally. The spell affects only the ally and lasts only until the end of your next turn. Your ally need not be willing if under the control of another creature. However, the controlling creature can attempt a DC 20 Will save, disrupting your activation on a success.
