<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 2+"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Wayfinder](/Equipment.aspx?ID=470)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 617

<row gap="medium">

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This compact compass repurposes ancient technology to draw fantastic powers from the mysterious magical items called [_aeon stones_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=407). It serves as a badge of office for agents of the Pathfinder Society and as a status symbol among adventurers of any stripe. 

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

<title
level="2"
right="Item 2"
pfs="Standard"
>
Wayfinder
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Evocation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=65" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Core Rulebook](/Sources.aspx?ID=1) pg. 617

_[**PFS Note**](/pathfinder-society) All Pathfinders have access._

**Price** 28 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

</column>

---

This compact compass repurposes ancient technology to draw fantastic powers from the mysterious magical items called [_aeon stones_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=407). It serves as a badge of office for agents of the Pathfinder Society and as a status symbol among adventurers of any stripe. A _wayfinder_ functions as a compass.

 An indentation in the middle of the _wayfinder_ can hold a single _aeon stone_. Placing an _aeon stone_ in this indentation provides you all the benefits of having the _aeon stone_ orbiting your head, but it protects the stone from being noticed or stolen as easily. You invest a _wayfinder_ and the _aeon stone_ within it simultaneously, and they count as only one item toward your investiture limit. An invested _aeon stone_ slotted in a _wayfinder_ also grants its resonant power.

 If you have more than one _wayfinder_ with an invested _aeon stone_ on your person at a given time, destructive interference from their resonance prevents you from gaining benefits from any of them. You can still benefit from additional _aeon stones_ orbiting your head, just not in _wayfinders_.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> command;     **Effect** The _wayfinder_ is targeted by a 1st-level [_light_](/Spells.aspx?ID=171) spell.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 2"
pfs="Standard"
>
Archaic Wayfinder
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Evocation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=65" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [World Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=6) pg. 17

_[**PFS Note**](/pathfinder-society) All characters have access to the archaic wayfinder_

**Price** 30 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

</row>

<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="" /><row>Cast a Spell</row></row>

</column>

---

An _archaic wayfinder_ functions as a compass and acts as a repository for one cantrip cast into it. To fill an _archaic wayfinder_, a spellcaster casts the chosen cantrip into the empty device, providing any necessary cost; the spell cannot be one that is normally cast as a free action or reaction. Activating an _archaic wayfinder_ is the same as the casting for the relevant spell. Once it has been activated, it becomes empty again. An _archaic wayfinder_ can hold an aeon stone and activate its resonant power. An _archaic wayfinder_ counts against the limit of one _wayfinder_ with a slotted resonant _[aeon stone](/Equipment.aspx?ID=407)_.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 4"
pfs="Limited"
>
Wayfinder of Rescue
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Evocation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=65" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [PFS Scenario #1-03: Escaping the Grave](/Sources.aspx?ID=9) pg. 42

**Price** 80 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

</column>

---

As a standard _wayfinder_, but once per day you can activate it to cast _[heal](/Spells.aspx?ID=148)_ on a creature other than yourself, using either the one-action or two-action version of _[heal](/Spells.aspx?ID=148)_ as a 1st-level spell.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 6"
pfs="Standard"
>
Bi-Resonant Wayfinder
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Evocation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=65" />
<trait label="Illusion" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=92" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Character Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=12) pg. 110

**Price** 200 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

**Access** A character who is a member of the Pathfinder Society has access to this option.

</column>

---

A _bi-resonant wayfinder_ is inlaid with intricate platinum wires in a complex array of conduits for magical energy. These conduits control the resonant interference of _aeon stones_. A _bi-resonant wayfinder_ works just like a regular _wayfinder_ except it has two _aeon stone_ slots, and the _aeon stones_ in both slots grant their resonant powers without interfering with each other. The _bi-resonant wayfinder_ and the two _aeon stones_ count as two items toward your investiture limit.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 4"
pfs="Standard"
>
Shining Wayfinder
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Abjuration" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=2" />
<trait label="Divination" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=47" />
<trait label="Evocation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=65" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Character Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=12) pg. 111

**Price** 100 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

**Access** A character who is a member of the Pathfinder Society has access to this option.

</column>

---

A _shining wayfinder_ is a polished silver compass blessed by the power of benevolent deities. It has the usual functions of a _wayfinder_, except instead of an activation to cast _light_, the shining wayfinder has the following two activations.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> command, Interact;     **Effect** You hold the _wayfinder_ and ask for guidance. The wayfinder casts [_guidance_](/Spells.aspx?ID=142) on you.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> command, Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You call upon the wayfinder’s divine blessings for yourself and your allies. The wayfinder casts [_bless_](/Spells.aspx?ID=25), with an emanation centered on itself. Once per turn, you can use a single action, which has the [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32) trait, to increase the emanation’s radius by 5 feet.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 5"
pfs="Standard"
>
Vanishing Wayfinder
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Evocation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=65" />
<trait label="Illusion" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=92" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Character Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=12) pg. 112

**Price** 150 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

**Access** A character who is a member of the Pathfinder Society has access to this option.

</column>

---

A _vanishing wayfinder_ is crafted of ivory chased with gold and silver. It has the usual functions of a _wayfinder_ and the following additional activation.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> command, Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You turn the _wayfinder_ in a circle while invoking its command word, gaining the effects of a 2nd-level [_invisibility_](/Spells.aspx?ID=164) spell for 5 minutes.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 6"
pfs="Limited"
>
Chronicler Wayfinder
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Evocation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=65" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [PFS Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=50) pg. 30

_[**PFS Note**](/pathfinder-society) Players can gain access to faction-specific gear by taking the corresponding Faction Gear Access Game Reward, available when they reach 20 reputation with the respective faction._

**Price** 200 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

**Access** Member of the Pathfinder Society.

</column>

---

_Chronicler wayfinders_ bear a mystical connection to the _Pathfinder Chronicles_ themselves, granting them the ability to assist in situations where unusual lore is needed by drawing on lore from a particular topic. Each _chronicler wayfinder_ is attuned to a specific [Lore](/Skills.aspx?ID=8) skill, chosen at the time of creation. In addition to the effects of a _wayfinder_, a chronicler wayfinder has the following activation.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> envision;     **Effect** You tap into the _Pathfinder Chronicles_ on the _chronicler wayfinder's_ attuned topic, gaining the effects of a [Recall Knowledge](/Actions.aspx?ID=26) action with the chosen Lore skill. For the Lore check's modifier, use whichever is better of +12 or your own modifier, using your level as your proficiency bonus even if you're untrained in the attuned Lore skill.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 10"
pfs="Limited"
>
Razmiri Wayfinder
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Illusion" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=92" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Necromancy" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=117" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [PFS Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=50) pg. 72

**Price** 900 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

</column>

---

Worn on a chain around the neck, a _Razmiri wayfinder_ functions as a [compass](/Equipment.aspx?ID=16) and provides its wearer a +1 item bonus to [Deception](/Skills.aspx?ID=5) checks to [Lie](/Actions.aspx?ID=47) or [Impersonate](/Actions.aspx?ID=46). _Razmiri wayfinders_ can also be used to grant temporary healing, making it easier for the wearer to impersonate a divine spellcaster.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> envision;  **Frequency** three times per day;   **Effect** You touch an adjacent creature, granting them 3d8 temporary Hit Points for 1 hour.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> manipulate;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You touch an adjacent creature and attempt a [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) check against one [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126) or [disease](/Traits.aspx?ID=46) afflicting the creature. On a success, you halt the effects of the poison or disease for 1 day, rather than removing it. This temporarily relieves any penalties imposed by the affliction but doesn't cure the effect or count against its duration; the poison or disease is merely halted for a time, and it resumes where it left off once this effect ends.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 9"
pfs="Standard"
>
Elemental Wayfinder (Air)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Air" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=5" />
<trait label="Evocation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=65" />
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [PFS Guide](/Sources.aspx?ID=50) pg. 122

_[**PFS Note**](/pathfinder-society) All characters affiliated with the Pathfinder Society have access to this item_

**Price** 650 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn

</row>

**Access** Member of the Pathfinder Society.

</column>

---

Pathfinder Society researchers recently created _elemental wayfinders_ with the assistance of the Society's elemental allies. Additionally, you can cast [_feather fall_](/Spells.aspx?ID=111) as a primal innate spell once every 10 minutes.

Item 2 Wayfinder Uncommon Evocation Invested Magical Source Core Rulebook pg. 617 PFS Note All Pathfinders have access. Price 28 gp Usage worn This compact compass repurposes ancient technology to draw fantastic powers from the mysterious magical items called aeon stones . It serves as a badge of office for agents of the Pathfinder Society and as a status symbol among adventurers of any stripe. A wayfinder functions as a compass. An indentation in the middle of the wayfinder can hold a single aeon stone . Placing an aeon stone in this indentation provides you all the benefits of having the aeon stone orbiting your head, but it protects the stone from being noticed or stolen as easily. You invest a wayfinder and the aeon stone within it simultaneously, and they count as only one item toward your investiture limit. An invested aeon stone slotted in a wayfinder also grants its resonant power. If you have more than one wayfinder with an invested aeon stone on your person at a given time, destructive interference from their resonance prevents you from gaining benefits from any of them. You can still benefit from additional aeon stones orbiting your head, just not in wayfinders . Activate Single Action command; Effect The wayfinder is targeted by a 1st-level light spell. Item 2 Archaic Wayfinder Uncommon Evocation Invested Magical Source World Guide pg. 17 PFS Note All characters have access to the archaic wayfinder Price 30 gp Usage held in 1 hand Activate Cast a Spell An archaic wayfinder functions as a compass and acts as a repository for one cantrip cast into it. To fill an archaic wayfinder , a spellcaster casts the chosen cantrip into the empty device, providing any necessary cost; the spell cannot be one that is normally cast as a free action or reaction. Activating an archaic wayfinder is the same as the casting for the relevant spell. Once it has been activated, it becomes empty again. An archaic wayfinder can hold an aeon stone and activate its resonant power. An archaic wayfinder counts against the limit of one wayfinder with a slotted resonant aeon stone . Item 4 Wayfinder of Rescue Uncommon Evocation Invested Magical Source PFS Scenario #1-03: Escaping the Grave pg. 42 Price 80 gp Usage worn As a standard wayfinder , but once per day you can activate it to cast heal on a creature other than yourself, using either the one-action or two-action version of heal as a 1st-level spell. Item 6 Bi-Resonant Wayfinder Uncommon Evocation Illusion Invested Magical Source Character Guide pg. 110 Price 200 gp Usage worn Access A character who is a member of the Pathfinder Society has access to this option. A bi-resonant wayfinder is inlaid with intricate platinum wires in a complex array of conduits for magical energy. These conduits control the resonant interference of aeon stones . A bi-resonant wayfinder works just like a regular wayfinder except it has two aeon stone slots, and the aeon stones in both slots grant their resonant powers without interfering with each other. The bi-resonant wayfinder and the two aeon stones count as two items toward your investiture limit. Item 4 Shining Wayfinder Uncommon Abjuration Divination Evocation Invested Magical Source Character Guide pg. 111 Price 100 gp Usage worn Access A character who is a member of the Pathfinder Society has access to this option. A shining wayfinder is a polished silver compass blessed by the power of benevolent deities. It has the usual functions of a wayfinder , except instead of an activation to cast light , the shining wayfinder has the following two activations. Activate Two Actions command, Interact; Effect You hold the wayfinder and ask for guidance. The wayfinder casts guidance on you. Activate Two Actions command, Interact; Frequency once per day; Effect You call upon the wayfinder’s divine blessings for yourself and your allies. The wayfinder casts bless , with an emanation centered on itself. Once per turn, you can use a single action, which has the concentrate trait, to increase the emanation’s radius by 5 feet. Item 5 Vanishing Wayfinder Uncommon Evocation Illusion Invested Magical Source Character Guide pg. 112 Price 150 gp Usage worn Access A character who is a member of the Pathfinder Society has access to this option. A vanishing wayfinder is crafted of ivory chased with gold and silver. It has the usual functions of a wayfinder and the following additional activation. Activate Two Actions command, Interact; Frequency once per day; Effect You turn the wayfinder in a circle while invoking its command word, gaining the effects of a 2nd-level invisibility spell for 5 minutes. Item 6 Chronicler Wayfinder Uncommon Evocation Invested Magical Source PFS Guide pg. 30 PFS Note Players can gain access to faction-specific gear by taking the corresponding Faction Gear Access Game Reward, available when they reach 20 reputation with the respective faction. Price 200 gp Usage worn Access Member of the Pathfinder Society. Chronicler wayfinders bear a mystical connection to the Pathfinder Chronicles themselves, granting them the ability to assist in situations where unusual lore is needed by drawing on lore from a particular topic. Each chronicler wayfinder is attuned to a specific Lore skill, chosen at the time of creation. In addition to the effects of a wayfinder , a chronicler wayfinder has the following activation. Activate Single Action envision; Effect You tap into the Pathfinder Chronicles on the chronicler wayfinder's attuned topic, gaining the effects of a Recall Knowledge action with the chosen Lore skill. For the Lore check's modifier, use whichever is better of +12 or your own modifier, using your level as your proficiency bonus even if you're untrained in the attuned Lore skill. Item 10 Razmiri Wayfinder Uncommon Illusion Magical Necromancy Source PFS Guide pg. 72 Price 900 gp Usage worn Worn on a chain around the neck, a Razmiri wayfinder functions as a compass and provides its wearer a +1 item bonus to Deception checks to Lie or Impersonate. Razmiri wayfinders can also be used to grant temporary healing, making it easier for the wearer to impersonate a divine spellcaster. Activate Single Action manipulate; Frequency once per day; Effect You touch an adjacent creature and attempt a counteract check against one poison or disease afflicting the creature. On a success, you halt the effects of the poison or disease for 1 day, rather than removing it. This temporarily relieves any penalties imposed by the affliction but doesn't cure the effect or count against its duration; the poison or disease is merely halted for a time, and it resumes where it left off once this effect ends. >
[Binding Coil](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1018)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Consumable" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=36" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Talisman" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=155" />
<trait label="Transmutation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=157" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Secrets of Magic](/Sources.aspx?ID=96) pg. 173

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** affixed to a weapon

</row>

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="Free Action" /><row>envision</row></row>

 

**Trigger** Your Strike with the affixed weapon damages a creature

**Requirement** You're an expert in [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3).
</row>

</column>

---

This talisman, a bright red coil that's warm to the touch and faintly resembles a serpent, wraps entirely around your weapon. When you activate this talisman's effect, attempt to [Grapple](/Actions.aspx?ID=35) the creature you hit. On a success, rather than the normal Grapple effects, the coil instead wraps itself around the target with one end remaining attached to your weapon. Your opponent must succeed at a DC 20 [Escape](/Actions.aspx?ID=79) check to break free. The coil breaks if you move any further away from the bound opponent, but not if you move any closer.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

---

This talisman, a bright red coil that's warm to the touch and faintly resembles a serpent, wraps entirely around your weapon. When you activate this talisman's effect, attempt to [Grapple](/Actions.aspx?ID=35) the creature you hit. On a success, rather than the normal Grapple effects, the coil instead wraps itself around the target with one end remaining attached to your weapon. Your opponent must succeed at a DC 20 [Escape](/Actions.aspx?ID=79) check to break free. The coil breaks if you move any further away from the bound opponent, but not if you move any closer.

---

A line of glands embedded in your skin secretes a chemical that glows when it interacts with the air. As a single action, you can activate your bioluminescent stripes to glow with a [bright light](/Rules.aspx?ID=2402) in a 20-foot radius and [dim light](/Rules.aspx?ID=2403) for the next 20 feet. While you are glowing, you can’t be [undetected](/Conditions.aspx?ID=96) and you take a –4 item penalty to [Stealth](/Skills.aspx?ID=48) checks to [Hide](/Actions.aspx?ID=2404) and [Sneak](/Actions.aspx?ID=2405). You can [Dismiss](/Actions.aspx?ID=2311) the glow as a free action.

For the next hour, whenever a creature drinks your blood, the elixir changes your blood into a foul-tasting acid as it mixes with the drinker’s saliva. **Failure** The creature takes 4d6 acid damage and is sickened 2.

[Black Hole Armor](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1842)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 14

**Price** 8,500 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn armor

**Bulk** 5
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Armor** [Fortress Plate](/Armor.aspx?ID=21)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

The joints of this black _+2 [greater resilient](/Equipment.aspx?ID=279) [fortification](/Equipment.aspx?ID=285) [fortress plate](/Armor.aspx?ID=21)_ look like swirling vortices of silver. Non-magical ammunition and thrown weapons aimed at you are destroyed after they hit you and deal damage or miss you. You also have resistance 10 to physical damage from ranged attacks.

 When an enemy's ranged attack misses you or hits you and deals no damage, the armor absorbs the projectile. When it has absorbed six projectiles, the armor glows at the joints.

**Activate** <actions string="Reaction" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per minute; **Trigger** A ranged weapon Strike targets a creature within 20 feet of you and the attacker hasn't yet rolled its attack;  **Effect** The triggering Strike targets you instead of its intended target.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645))   **Requirements** The _black hole armor_ has absorbed six or more projectiles; **Effect** All the projectiles absorbed by the armor appear out of thin air, as though transported there, falling in a 10-foot burst within 120 feet of you. Each creature in the burst takes 10d8 piercing damage with a DC 35 Reflex save. The absorbed projectiles are all expended, and the armor's joints stop glowing.

</column>

---

The _black king_ is a _+2 [greater striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=280) [ashen](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2550) [blunderbuss](/Weapons.aspx?ID=196)_. While the dark metal frame is still pleasant to look at, this design prioritizes destructive power over aesthetic appeal. This specialized blunderbuss has a [scatter](/Traits.aspx?ID=413) radius of 20 feet instead of 10, and all [splash](/Traits.aspx?ID=150) damage it deals is negative damage instead of physical. Due to the risk of collateral damage, this weapon is typically only used by the especially foolhardy or reckless.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> envision, Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You unleash a blast of draining flame, dealing 5d6 fire damage and 5d6 negative damage to all creatures in a 60 foot cone (DC 34 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save). Creatures who fail their saving throw are [knocked back](/Rules.aspx?ID=451) 5 feet. Creatures who critically fail are knocked back 10 feet and fall [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=31).

    pfs="Standard"
>
[Black Powder](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1190)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Alchemical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=6" />
<trait label="Consumable" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=36" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Guns & Gears (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=98) pg. 169

<row gap="medium">
**Ammunition** round

</row>

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="Single Action" /><row>([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104))</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Black powder is a volatile and explosive alchemical substance commonly used in the production of firearm munitions. Black powder becomes inert and useless when wet and must be kept in a sealed, water-tight container.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

<title
level="2"
right="Item 0"
pfs="Standard"
>
Black Powder (Dose or Round)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Guns & Gears (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=98) pg. 169

**Price** 1 cp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

The smallest unit of black powder that still has a simple use, a dose can be a simple package paper parcel around black powder or it can be packaged with a metal bullet or pellet to be used as ammunition. When ignited with a fuse or exposed to direct flame, a dose of black powder explodes. This isn't powerful enough to deal damage but makes a loud sound and could trigger further explosions. A fuse for a dose can be created with a few twists of paper and causes the dose to explode the round after it's lit.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 2"
pfs="Standard"
>
Black Powder (Horn)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Guns & Gears (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=98) pg. 169

**Price** 5 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

A horn contains 500 doses worth of black powder. A horn can be detonated by leaving a small trail of black powder and then lighting it. Each 5-foot square requires one dose of black powder to create a trail through. As long as the horn is mostly full (at least 400 doses remaining) it can be detonated to deal 1d6 fire damage in a 5-foot burst (DC 16 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save). It takes 1 round per 15 feet of powder trail laid down for a horn to detonate after the trail is lit. If multiple horns detonate simultaneously, it can increase the area of the explosion, but the damage in overlapping areas doesn't increase.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 6"
pfs="Standard"
>
Black Powder (Keg)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Guns & Gears (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=98) pg. 169

**Price** 50 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

A keg contains 5,000 doses of black powder and can be detonated in the same way as a horn. As long as the keg is mostly full (at least 4,000 doses remaining) this deals 3d6 fire damage in a 20-foot burst (DC 20 basic Reflex save). Detonating multiple kegs can increase the area, but not the damage, of this effect; detonating a keg and any horns at the same time in an overlapping area also doesn't increase the damage.

<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="Single Action" /><row>Interact</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Black powder is a volatile and explosive alchemical substance commonly used in the production of firearm munitions. Black powder becomes inert and useless when wet and must be kept in a sealed, water-tight container.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

<title
level="2"
right="Item 0"
pfs="Standard"
>
Black Powder (Dose or Round)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Guns & Gears](/Sources.aspx?ID=318) pg. 169

**Price** 1 cp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

The smallest unit of black powder that still has a simple use, a dose can be a simple package paper parcel around black powder or it can be packaged with a metal bullet or pellet to be used as ammunition. When ignited with a fuse or exposed to direct flame, a dose of black powder explodes. This isn’t powerful enough to deal damage but makes a loud sound and could trigger further explosions. A fuse for a dose can be created with a few twists of paper and causes the dose to explode the round after it’s lit.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 2"
pfs="Standard"
>
Black Powder (Horn)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Guns & Gears](/Sources.aspx?ID=318) pg. 169

**Price** 5 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

A horn contains 500 doses worth of black powder. A horn can be detonated by leaving a small trail of black powder and then lighting it. Each 5-foot square requires one dose of black powder to create a trail through. As long as the horn is mostly full (at least 400 doses remaining) it can be detonated to deal 1d6 fire damage in a 5-foot [burst](/Rules.aspx?ID=2385) (DC 16 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=2297) Reflex save). It takes 1 round per 15 feet of powder trail laid down for a horn to detonate after the trail is lit. If multiple horns detonate simultaneously, it can increase the area of the explosion, but the damage in overlapping areas doesn’t increase.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 6"
pfs="Standard"
>
Black Powder (Keg)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Guns & Gears](/Sources.aspx?ID=318) pg. 169

**Price** 50 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

A keg contains 5,000 doses of black powder and can be detonated in the same way as a horn. As long as the keg is mostly full (at least 4,000 doses remaining) this deals 3d6 fire damage in a 20-foot [burst](/Rules.aspx?ID=2385) (DC 20 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=2297) Reflex save). Detonating multiple kegs can increase the area, but not the damage, of this effect; detonating a keg and any horns at the same time in an overlapping area also doesn’t increase the damage.

The massive stinger of a black scorpion adds significant weight to this _[+2](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2830) [greater striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2829) [fearsome](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2837) [mace](/Weapons.aspx?ID=362)_. On a critical hit, the target is exposed to black scorpion venom.

**Bulk** 2
</row>

---

This potent weapon used by [Treerazer](/Monsters.aspx?ID=3218) is a _+4 [greater corrosive](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2834) [major striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2829) obsidian [greataxe](/Weapons.aspx?ID=376)_ that grants a +4 item bonus to attack rolls, deals an extra 2d6 damage to [plants](/Traits.aspx?ID=668), and has the properties of [adamantine](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2855). It deals an additional die of damage when wielded by Treerazer.

**Activate—Owner’s Authority** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [scrying](/Traits.aspx?ID=689))   **Requirements** You aren’t wielding _Blackaxe_ and you are its true owner; **Effect** You sense the world around _Blackaxe_ as though you were in its location and can use any of your innate spells through the link as if it were the source of the spell. If another creature is wielding _Blackaxe_, it must succeed at a DC 50 Will save or be [slowed 2](/Conditions.aspx?ID=92) until it relinquishes the weapon.

**Activate—Owner’s Reclamation** <actions string="Free Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [teleportation](/Traits.aspx?ID=710))   **Requirements** You aren’t wielding _Blackaxe_ and you are its true owner; **Effect** _Blackaxe_ appears in your hands, teleporting instantly from its prior location.

**Activate—Rejuvenating Deforestation** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [death](/Traits.aspx?ID=571), [healing](/Traits.aspx?ID=623), [positive](/Traits.aspx?ID=509)) **Frequency** once per minute;   **Effect** Make a [Strike](/Actions.aspx?ID=2306) against a living tree with _Blackaxe_. If it hits, the tree withers to ash and you heal 250 Hit Points and gain the benefit of a 6th-rank [_sound body_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1679) spell.

**Destruction** Chop a powerful magical tree with _Blackaxe_, and while the sap is still fresh, sever one of [Cyth-V’sug’s](/Deities.aspx?ID=74) limbs. This makes _Blackaxe_ explode violently.

</column>

---

This oily, dark purple powder gives off the distinct odor of boiled leather. When delivered, the poison acts quickly to constrict the victim's blood flow to their extremities and turn their lungs into a soft jelly. A victim of blackfinger blight is recognizable by the pores of their fingertips weeping an inky oil that coats their hands and makes it difficult to hold things. Each round, at the beginning of their turn, a creature affected by blackfinger blight must succeed at a flat DC 5 check or drop one random item they're holding.

 **Saving Throw** DC 32 Fortitude; **Onset** 1 round; **Maximum Duration** 6 rounds; **Stage 1** 6d6 poison damage (1 round); **Stage 2** 8d6 poison damage (1 round); **Stage 3** 10d6 poison damage and [confused](/Conditions.aspx?ID=5) (1 round)

You can Activate the blade byrnie in place of an Interact action to draw a weapon for abilities such as the [Quick Draw](/Feats.aspx?ID=498) feat.

 Upgrading the runes on the _blade byrnie_ makes the daggers pulled from it more powerful. The daggers have a [_+2 weapon potency_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=281) rune if the armor has a [_+2 armor potency_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=278) rune, or a _+3 weapon potency_ rune if the armor has a _+3 armor potency_ rune.

>
[Blade Launcher](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1096)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Guns & Gears (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=98) pg. 64

**Price** 18 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Hands** 2

**Usage** held in 2 hands

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

A blade launcher has a bow-like assembly mounted on a handled frame. The frame can be configured to fire either a [dagger](/Weapons.aspx?ID=3), [dart](/Weapons.aspx?ID=68), [shuriken](/Weapons.aspx?ID=79), or [starknife](/Weapons.aspx?ID=44). Configuring a blade launcher requires three Interact actions. Once properly configured, loading an appropriate [thrown](/Traits.aspx?ID=195) weapon into a blade launcher requires a single Interact action. A blade launcher can't fire weapons for which it's not currently configured. A weapon fired with a blade launcher loses the [agile](/Traits.aspx?ID=170), [monk](/Traits.aspx?ID=112), [thrown](/Traits.aspx?ID=195), and [versatile](/Traits.aspx?ID=200) traits, if it has them, and has a range increment of 40 feet. Due to losing the thrown weapon trait, [_returning_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=301) and most other effects that allow a weapon to return don't function; even if a launched weapon did return, you'd still need to load it into the blade launcher with an Interact action to fire the blade launcher again.

>
[Blade of Fallen Stars](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2574)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Unique" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=161" />
<trait label="Artifact" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=253" />
<trait label="Combination" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=417" />
<trait label="Evocation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=65" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Highhelm](/Sources.aspx?ID=204) pg. 115

<row gap="medium">

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Weapon** [Gun Sword](/Weapons.aspx?ID=218)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This _+4 [major striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=280) [greater frost](/Equipment.aspx?ID=296) [gun sword](/Weapons.aspx?ID=218)_ is made from [high-grade cold siccatite](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1426). This gun sword's elegant, silvery blade is double-edged and etched with stars and constellations that move and mirror the night sky. The blade absorbs starlight, and prolonged exposure causes it to form a layer of glittering residue. Smiths in Dongun Hold forged this weapon by combining the cracked remains of a skymetal [arquebus](/Weapons.aspx?ID=195) and the shards of an exceptional [elven](/Ancestries.aspx?ID=2) [greatsword](/Weapons.aspx?ID=24). Some tales of the forging report that the sword was _Tear of Eventide_, a great blade forged out of starlight for the battle between [Desna](/Deities.aspx?ID=5) and Aolar. Whether or not that was the case, dwarven curators who examined the shards simply noted that the blade's material was compatible with the cracked gun. After an extremely tense diplomatic brunch, the weapon is now regarded as a miracle of elven artistry and dwarven engineering, and a powerful symbol of allyship between their kingdoms.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> Interact;     **Effect** You unfold the parrying hooks extending from the blade to form a bipod, which has the same benefits as a typical [tripod](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1207). This negates the –2 penalty from [kickback](/Traits.aspx?ID=409) but must be reversed by a subsequent Interact action before the weapon can be repositioned or wielded in melee.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> command, Interact;    **Requirements** The _blade of fallen stars_ was exposed to starlight for at least one hour since the last time this ability was used; **Effect** The coating on the blade seeps into the engravings and is collected in the barrel. On your next ranged Strike, the weapon fires a glowing white projectile with a blazing blue tail that explodes on impact. In addition to the normal Strike damage, the projectile also deals 6d8 cold damage and creates a [_faerie fire_](/Spells.aspx?ID=107) effect in a 5-foot emanation centered on the target.

**Destruction** Depriving the weapon of all light, natural or otherwise, for seven years, seven months, and seven days will cause it to crumble and erode irreparably

The wooden hilt is adorned with four gems, representing the energies of acid, cold, fire, and electricity, that sparkle in sequence at random intervals.

**Activate** <actions string="Free Action" /> Interact;  **Frequency** once per round;   **Effect** You draw magical energy from one of the gems. Roll 1d4. The blade of four energies casts a 5th-level spell that depends on the active rune: [_acid arrow_](/Spells.aspx?ID=2) for _corrosive_, [_fireball_](/Spells.aspx?ID=119) for _flaming_, [_cone of cold_](/Spells.aspx?ID=47) for _frost_, or [_lightning bolt_](/Spells.aspx?ID=172) for _shock_, with a DC of 30 and spell attack bonus of +20.

The wooden hilt is adorned with four gems, representing the energies of acid, cold, fire, and electricity, that sparkle in sequence at random intervals. Activate Free Action Interact; Frequency once per round; Effect You draw magical energy from one of the gems. Roll 1d4. Until the start of your next turn, the weapon gains the corresponding rune: 1— corrosive , 2— flaming , 3— frost , or 4— shock . Activate Two Actions command, envision; Frequency once per day; Requirements The blade has an energy rune from the first activation; Effect You call upon the energy stored in the blade to explode outward. This _+2 [greater striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=280) [shifting](/Equipment.aspx?ID=302) [shortsword](/Weapons.aspx?ID=43)_ is formed of rapidly vibrating air and magical energy, though it uses the same statistics as iron. The wooden hilt is adorned with four gems, representing the energies of acid, cold, fire, and electricity, that sparkle in sequence at random intervals.

**Activate** <actions string="Free Action" /> Interact;  **Frequency** once per round;   **Effect** You draw magical energy from one of the gems. Roll 1d4. Until the start of your next turn, the weapon gains the corresponding rune: 1—[_corrosive_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=292), 2—[_flaming_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=295), 3—[_frost_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=296), or 4—[_shock_](/Equipment.aspx?ID=303).

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> command, envision;  **Frequency** once per day;  **Requirements** The blade has an energy rune from the first activation; **Effect** You call upon the energy stored in the blade to explode outward. The blade of four energies casts a 5th-level spell that depends on the active rune: [_acid arrow_](/Spells.aspx?ID=2) for _corrosive_, [_fireball_](/Spells.aspx?ID=119) for _flaming_, [_cone of cold_](/Spells.aspx?ID=47) for _frost_, or [_lightning bolt_](/Spells.aspx?ID=172) for _shock_, with a DC of 30 and spell attack bonus of +20.

**Activate—Release Energy** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per day;  **Requirements** The blade has an energy rune from Cycle Energy; **Effect** You call upon the energy stored in the blade to explode outward. You cast a 5th-rank spell that depends on the active rune: [_acid grip_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1436) for _corrosive_, _[_fireball_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1530)_ for _flaming_, 2-action _[_howling blizzard_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1559)_ for _frost_, or _[_lightning bolt_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1586)_ for _shock_, with a DC of 30.

</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Unique" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=161" />
<trait label="Electricity" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=56" />
<trait label="Evocation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=65" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Legends](/Sources.aspx?ID=40) pg. 76

**Price** 6,500 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 2 hands

**Bulk** 2
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Weapon** [Greatsword](/Weapons.aspx?ID=24)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This _+2 [greater striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=280) [shock](/Equipment.aspx?ID=303) [greatsword](/Weapons.aspx?ID=24)_ is forged from [standard-grade adamantine](/Equipment.aspx?ID=374), with inlays of broken circuitry and a robot's ocular lens on the cross guard. A soft thrum comes from the blade, which you feel as a subtle pulse through the grip when wielding it. It sparks when unsheathed, emitting dim light within 5 feet. On a hit against a foe made of metal, wearing metal armor, or using a metal shield, if the foe takes electricity damage from the blade, the makes the foe [flat-footed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=16) for 1 round; if the Strike was a critical hit, it also makes them [clumsy 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=3) for 1 round.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> command, Interact;     **Effect** You cast the [_electric arc_](/Spells.aspx?ID=97) cantrip from the sword as an 8th-level primal spell, using 10 + your melee attack modifier with the _Blade of the Black Sovereign_ as your spell DC.

fields.text: Item 15 Blade of the Black Sovereign Unique Electricity Evocation Magical Source Legends pg. 76 Price 6,500 gp Usage held in 2 hands Bulk 2 Base Weapon Greatsword This +2 greater striking shock greatsword is forged from standard-grade adamantine, with inlays of broken circuitry and a robot's ocular lens on the cross guard. A soft thrum comes from the blade, which you feel as a subtle pulse through the grip when wielding it. It sparks when unsheathed, emitting dim light within 5 feet. On a hit against a foe made of metal, wearing metal armor, or using a metal shield, if the foe takes electricity damage from the blade, the makes the foe flat-footed for 1 round; if the Strike was a critical hit, it also makes them clumsy 1 for 1 round. Activate Two Actions command, Interact; Effect You cast the electric arc cantrip from the sword as an 8th-level primal spell, using 10 + your melee attack modifier with the Blade of the Black Sovereign as your spell DC.

    right="Item 15"
    pfs=""
>
[Blade of the Rabbit Prince](/Equipment.aspx?ID=836)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Agents of Edgewatch</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Transmutation" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=157" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #160: Assault on Hunting Lodge Seven](/Sources.aspx?ID=49) pg. 66

**Price** 6,250 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** 1
</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Weapon** [Shortsword](/Weapons.aspx?ID=43)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This _+2 [greater striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=280) [dancing](/Equipment.aspx?ID=293) [shortsword](/Weapons.aspx?ID=43)_ has a golden handguard resembling a bird with outstretched wings. The sword's blade is broken halfway up its length, but this doesn't impair the sword's function.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> command, Interact;     **Effect** You attempt to [Trip](/Actions.aspx?ID=40) or [Disarm](/Actions.aspx?ID=41) an opponent using [Thievery](/Skills.aspx?ID=17) instead of [Athletics](/Skills.aspx?ID=3), and you add the _blade of the Rabbit Prince's_ item bonus to the check. You do not need to have a hand free if you're wielding the _blade of the Rabbit Prince_, and your target can be up to two sizes larger than you.

**Craft Requirements** You must craft the blade in the Harrowed Realm.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Consumable" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=36" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Whetstone" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=861" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Battlecry!](/Sources.aspx?ID=268) pg. 134

**Price** 300 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="Single Action" /><row>([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645))</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

A _blade phantom’s guide_ is a metal rectangle, often on a chain, etched with an image of a warrior in a fighting stance. When you apply a _blade phantom’s guide_ to a weapon, it summons a spiritual fragment of a warrior who was adept with that weapon. For 1 minute, you treat your proficiency with that weapon as equal to your highest weapon proficiency. This effect cannot affect a weapon whose level is higher than the _blade phantom’s guide_ (11th).

<title
    level="1"
    right="Item 7"
    pfs="Standard"
>
[Blakenshipper](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3927)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Battlecry!](/Sources.aspx?ID=268) pg. 142

**Price** 340 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 2 hands

**Bulk** 2
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This strange instrument is both played and worn, consisting of a set of pipes on a metal arm attached to a harness, a horn, a drum attached to a foot pedal, arm bellows, various keys, cymbals, and more esoteric elements. The blakenshipper grants you a +1 item bonus to [Performance](/Skills.aspx?ID=45) checks while playing music with the instrument.

**Activate—Be the Band** <actions string="Three Actions" /> ([auditory](/Traits.aspx?ID=541), [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You work double-time, playing an entire band’s composition yourself, bolstering those around you by your mighty effort. You and all allies within a 60-foot [emanation](/Rules.aspx?ID=2387) gain 15 [temporary Hit Points](/Rules.aspx?ID=2321) that last for 1 round. For the next minute, you can [Sustain](/Actions.aspx?ID=2317) to continue the music, granting you and all allies within a 60-foot emanation 5 temporary Hit Points that last for 1 round; this Sustain action gains the auditory and manipulate traits.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

[Blast Boots](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1104)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Consumable" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=36" />
<trait label="Gadget" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=405" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Guns & Gears (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=98) pg. 67

_[**PFS Note**](/pathfinder-society) All Pathfinder Society agents have access to all uncommon clockwork items and gadgets from Chapters 1 and 2 of this book_

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn (attached to footwear or feet)

**Bulk** L
</row>

**Access**  Due to the use of technology, all gadgets are uncommon or rare, though inventors and regions with access to inventors have access to uncommon gadgets.

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="Single Action" /><row>([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104))</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

These sets of rockets come in pairs and strap onto existing footwear (or a creature's feet). Inserting them and aligning them properly takes 1 minute. When you Activate the blast boots, you can [High Jump](/Actions.aspx?ID=36) or [Long Jump](/Actions.aspx?ID=37), without the need to Stride first. Higher-level versions increase the distance of your High Jump or Long Jump.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

</title>

</traits>

**Price** 11 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Bulk** L

</row>

</column>

---

When you Activate the moderate blast boots to High Jump, you can increase the vertical distance of your High Jump by up to 30 feet. When you Activate them to Long Jump, you can increase the horizontal distance of your Long Jump by up to 45 feet.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 9"
pfs="Standard"
>
Blast Boots (Greater)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Guns & Gears (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=98) pg. 67

**Price** 140 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Bulk** L

</row>

</column>

---

When you Activate the greater blast boots to High Jump, you can increase the vertical distance of your High Jump by up to 50 feet. When you Activate them to Long Jump, you can increase the horizontal distance of your Long Jump by up to 75 feet. Additionally, for 1 minute, the greater blast boots continue to boost your jumps. Every time you [Leap](/Actions.aspx?ID=81) during the duration, you can move 30 feet in any direction, or your normal Leap distance, whichever is further.

<title
level="2"
right="Item 17"
pfs="Standard"
>
Blast Boots (Major)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Guns & Gears (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=98) pg. 67

**Price** 2,750 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Bulk** L

</row>

</column>

---

When you Activate the major blast boots to High Jump, you can increase the vertical distance of your High Jump by up to 80 feet. When you Activate them to Long Jump, you can increase the horizontal distance of your Long Jump by up to 120 feet. Additionally, for 1 minute, the major blast boots remain active, allowing you to clumsily fly through the air for the duration. You gain a 30-foot Fly speed for the duration, but any time you Fly, you are [clumsy 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=3) until the start of your next turn.

Activate Single Action Interact These sets of rockets come in pairs and strap onto existing footwear (or a creature’s feet). Inserting them and aligning them properly takes 1 minute. When you Activate the blast boots, you can High Jump or Long Jump, without the need to Stride first. Higher-level versions increase the distance of your High Jump or Long Jump. Item 1 Blast Boots (Lesser) Source Guns & Gears pg. 67 Price 3 gp Item 3 Blast Boots (Moderate) Source Guns & Gears pg. 67 Price 11 gp When you Activate the moderate blast boots to High Jump, you can increase the vertical distance of your High Jump by up to 30 feet. When you Activate them to Long Jump, you can increase the horizontal distance of your Long Jump by up to 45 feet. Item 9 Blast Boots (Greater) Source Guns & Gears pg. 67 Price 140 gp When you Activate the greater blast boots to High Jump, you can increase the vertical distance of your High Jump by up to 50 feet. When you Activate them to Long Jump, you can increase the horizontal distance of your Long Jump by up to 75 feet. Additionally, for 1 minute, the greater blast boots continue to boost your jumps. Every time you Leap during the duration, you can move 30 feet in any direction, or your normal Leap distance, whichever is further. Item 17 Blast Boots (Major) Source Guns & Gears pg. 67 Price 2,750 gp When you Activate the major blast boots to High Jump, you can increase the vertical distance of your High Jump by up to 80 feet. When you Activate them to Long Jump, you can increase the horizontal distance of your Long Jump by up to 120 feet. Additionally, for 1 minute, the major blast boots remain active, allowing you to clumsily fly through the air for the duration. You gain a 30-foot Fly speed for the duration, but any time you Fly, you are clumsy 1 until the start of your next turn.

<traits>

These sets of rockets come in pairs and strap onto existing footwear (or a creature's feet). Inserting them and aligning them properly takes 1 minute. When you Activate the blast boots, you can [High Jump](/Actions.aspx?ID=36) or [Long Jump](/Actions.aspx?ID=37), without the need to Stride first. Higher-level versions increase the distance of your High Jump or Long Jump.

These prosthetic feet and legs, created by dwarven alchemists and spellcasters together, are engraved with simple but effective evocation symbols on the ball and heel, empowering you to leap to great heights and blast foes with your feet.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> envision;  **Frequency** once per 10 minutes;   **Effect** You blast off from the ground, using the force to leap through the air. The _blast feet_ cast [_jump_](/Spells.aspx?ID=167) on you.

A barrel running down the length of the lance allows you to load firearm ammunition into the base of the weapon more easily than it might seem from the design. It takes 2 actions to [reload](/Traits.aspx?ID=254) a _blast lance_. **Activate** command; **Trigger** You strike a foe with the _blast lance_; **Requirements** The _blast lance_ is loaded with a round; **Effect** You fire a blast of gunpowder through the weapon that deals 2d8 fire damage. The foe must attempt a DC 18 Fortitude save. **Critical Success** The target is unaffected by the blast of gunpowder and the _blast lance_ [misfires and jams](/Rules.aspx?ID=1649).
**Success** The target takes half the fire damage.
**Failure** The target takes the full fire damage and is [pushed back](/Rules.aspx?ID=451) 5 feet. You can Stride after it, but you must move the same distance and in the same direction.
**Critical Failure** The target takes double damage and is pushed back 10 feet. You can Stride after it, but you must move the same distance and in the same direction. Blast Lance **Source** [Pathfinder #180: The Smoking Gun](/Sources.aspx?ID=125) pg. 74 **Price** 100 gp **Bulk** 2 Blast Lance (Greater) **Source** [Pathfinder #180: The Smoking Gun](/Sources.aspx?ID=125) pg. 74 **Price** 500 gp **Bulk** 2 --- A _greater blast lance_ is a _+1 [striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=280) lance_ whose blast deals 3d8 fire damage instead of 2d8 fire damage. The Fortitude save DC is 24.

---

Crafted from heavy steel plating and riveted together with cunning precision, this suit of _+1 [resilient](/Equipment.aspx?ID=279) [full plate](/Armor.aspx?ID=13)_ is specifically designed to protect against sudden explosions. This added layer of security comes at the cost of movement, however.

**Activate** <actions string="Reaction" /> command;   **Trigger** You're affected by an area effect that requires a Reflex save, or you would take [splash](/Traits.aspx?ID=150) damage from a [scatter](/Traits.aspx?ID=413) weapon;  **Effect** The _blast suit_ locks together into a rigid bulwark, protecting you from the blast but preventing you from moving from your position under any circumstances. You become [immobilized](/Conditions.aspx?ID=24), gain a +2 circumstance bonus to your Reflex save against area effects, and gain resistance 5 to all damage you would normally take from area effects and scatter splash damage (this doesn't damage the _blast suit_). These effects persist for as long as the suit remains in the locked position. You can Interact with the suit to unlock it.

</column>

This metal canister of explosive compounds is inspired by the blastpack, simplifying the technology for day-to-day use— though only a goblin could say what daily tasks warrant such a tool. [Blazons of Shared Power](/Equipment.aspx?ID=1221)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Invested" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=98" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Guns & Gears (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=98) pg. 183

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn and attached to two weapons (see below)

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

These brass emblems come in a variety of designs, usually customized to the purchaser to reflect the heraldry of a family or guild. _Blazons of shared power_ come in sets of three. When you invest the blazons, you wear one of the three on your chest, and you attach the others to a pair of one-handed weapons, choosing one as the primary weapon and one as the secondary weapon. These weapons can be either melee weapons or ranged weapons. As long as you're wielding both the primary weapon and the secondary weapon, the secondary weapon gains the benefit of the fundamental runes on the primary weapon. A weapon can only have a single blazon of shared power attached to it at a time.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

pfs="Standard"
>
Blazons of Shared Power
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

**Price** 52 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

Blazons of Shared Power (Greater)
</title>

<traits>

</traits>

**Source** [Guns & Gears (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=98) pg. 183

**Price** 1,350 gp

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</column>

---

A set of _greater blazons of shared power_ also replicates property runes from the primary weapon, so long as the secondary weapon meets all the prerequisites for a given rune and isn't a specific weapon. The secondary weapon gains the benefits of those runes. All of its own runes are suppressed. When you invest the blazons, you can elect for them to transfer only fundamental runes, in which case they function as standard _blazons of shared power_.

[Bleachguard Doll](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2393)
</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Rare" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=137" />
<trait label="No Alignment" url="/Rules.aspx?ID=95" />
<trait label="Intelligent" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=280" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 194

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

<column gap="tiny">

**Perception** +16; [precise](/Rules.aspx?ID=411) vision ([low-light](/Rules.aspx?ID=416)) 30 feet, [imprecise](/Rules.aspx?ID=412) hearing 30 feet

**Communication** speech (one language spoken by the doll's creator)

**Skills** One Intelligence-, Wisdom-, or Charisma-based skill chosen by the creator at +16

**Int** +3, **Wis** +3, **Cha** +3

**Will** +16 

</column>

---        

Rather than seeking out new experiences to stave off the Bleaching, [gnome](/Ancestries.aspx?ID=3) spellcasters with the right know-how can infuse a small fragment of their consciousness into a doll, then send the doll off with a crew of adventurers to experience new things. Such gnomes might have difficulties that keep them from exploring or might be preoccupied with other pursuits, but the doll acts as an intermediary, transmitting the benefits of new experiences to its creator via a potent, but passive, psychic link. A _bleachguard doll_ has the alignment and demeanor of its creator, but new experiences can cause the two to diverge. The doll's creator is neither able to control it nor are they constantly aware of its activities. If the original creator perishes, the doll sometimes becomes inert (essentially dying as well), sometimes remains an intelligent item, and sometimes becomes a normal [soulbound doll](/Monsters.aspx?ID=383), diminished in power but with some of the item's capabilities.

 Once per day, the doll sends its creator a dream of the day’s events. Each _bleachguard doll_ can cast the cantrips [_light_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1585) (3rd rank), [_prestidigitation_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1639), and one other 3rd-rank cantrip, along with one spell (at 3rd rank) that can be cast once per day. The creator chooses the cantrip and spells, which can’t require an attack roll or saving throw, during the doll’s creation.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645))    **Effect** The _bleachguard doll_ casts one of its available cantrips or spells.

**Activate** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The _bleachguard doll_ animates per [_summon construct_](/Spells.aspx?ID=318) as a soulbound doll, retaining pertinent item statistics, cantrips, and its spell instead of those of the soulbound doll. The _soulbound doll_ can Cast a Spell only if the bleachguard doll has a use of that spell remaining for the day. When reduced to 0 Hit Points or this activation ends, the _bleachguard doll_ becomes inert but repairs itself at the rate of 1 Hit Point per hour. This activation is unavailable until the doll has 23 Hit Points again.

</column>

The soulbound doll can Cast a Spell only if the _bleachguard doll_ has a use of that spell remaining for the day. When reduced to 0 Hit Points or this activation ends, the _bleachguard doll_ becomes inert but repairs itself at the rate of 1 Hit Point per hour. This foul-smelling bottle contains compressed, noxious fumes. After you inhale the odious gases of the blight breath, you gain resistance 10 to [poison](/Traits.aspx?ID=126) for as long as you hold your breath. You can exhale the blight breath as a single action. The resulting spray of noxious fumes deals 10d6 poison damage to each creature in a 15-foot cone, with a DC 29 [basic](/Rules.aspx?ID=329) Reflex save.

Blightburn bombs have radioactive materials sealed inside flasks treated with lead. The bomb grants an item bonus to attack rolls and deals poison damage, [persistent poison damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29), and poison [splash](/Traits.aspx?ID=150) damage, according to the bomb's type. A creature that takes the persistent poison damage deals the splash damage again from its current position as the radiation continues to harm nearby creatures. The persistent damage can last up to 1 minute. Blightburn bombs also expose the primary target to [blightburn sickness](/Diseases.aspx?ID=24) at the listed Fortitude DC.

</title>

<column gap="tiny">

**Price** 40 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="Single Action" /><row>Strike</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Though expensive, these single-use alchemical bombs are often used by police forces to disperse unruly crowds and quell riots without risking permanent physical injury to either officers or civilians. The bomb can be thrown up to 30 feet, causing it to explode, spraying the aerosolized pepper dust in a 15-foot-radius burst. All creatures in the area must succeed at a DC 18 Reflex save to avoid inhaling the dust or getting it in their eyes. On a failed save, the creature is [blinded](/Conditions.aspx?ID=1) for 1 round and then [dazzled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=7) for 1 round. On a critical failure, the creature is blinded for 1 round, [sickened 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=34), and dazzled until it removes the sickened condition.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>

This single-use pacification device consists of finely ground hot pepper loaded into a sealed, blowgun-style tube with a one-way valve and a range of 5 feet. To use it, the wielder must tear open the tube's seal as an Interact action, then spend another action to blow the hot pepper into an adjacent creature's face. These actions don't have to be taken in the same round. The target must attempt a DC 15 Reflex save to avoid inhaling the pepper or getting it in their eyes. On a failed save, the creature is [blinded](/Conditions.aspx?ID=1) for 1 round and then [dazzled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=7) for 1 round. On a critical failure, the creature is blinded for 1 round, [sickened 1](/Conditions.aspx?ID=34), and dazzled until it removes the sickened condition.

Blister ammunition is loaded with alchemically processed irritants, such as pollen, pepper, and formic acid. A creature hit by activated blister ammunition must attempt a Fortitude save or begin to itch uncontrollably in addition to damage the attack normally deals. On a critical hit, increase the Fortitude DC by 2, and the target is [dazzled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=7) for 1 round. For the duration, each time the target attempts a [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32) action, it must attempt a DC 8 flat check, losing the action on a failure. An affected creature can use a single Interact action to scratch and sneeze, allowing it to automatically pass the flat check. The effect ends early once an affected creature spends 3 Interact actions scratching and sneezing. These Interact actions don't need to be consecutive.

<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="Single Action" /><row>Interact</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

Blister ammunition is loaded with alchemically processed irritants, such as pollen, pepper, and formic acid. A creature hit by activated blister ammunition must attempt a Fortitude save or begin to itch uncontrollably in addition to damage the attack normally deals. On a critical hit, increase the Fortitude DC by 2, and the target is [dazzled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=65) for 1 round. For the duration, each time the target attempts a [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561) action, it must attempt a DC 8 [flat check](/Rules.aspx?ID=333), losing the action on a failure. An affected creature can use a single Interact action to scratch and sneeze, allowing it to automatically pass the flat check. The effect ends early once an affected creature spends 3 [Interact](/Actions.aspx?ID=2297) actions scratching and sneezing. These Interact actions don’t need to be consecutive.

</column>

Blister ammunition is loaded with alchemically processed irritants, such as pollen, pepper, and formic acid. A creature hit by activated blister ammunition must attempt a Fortitude save or begin to itch uncontrollably in addition to damage the attack normally deals. On a critical hit, increase the Fortitude DC by 2, and the target is [dazzled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=7) for 1 round. For the duration, each time the target attempts a [concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32) action, it must attempt a DC 8 flat check, losing the action on a failure. An affected creature can use a single Interact action to scratch and sneeze, allowing it to automatically pass the flat check. The effect ends early once an affected creature spends 3 Interact actions scratching and sneezing. These Interact actions don't need to be consecutive.

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Treasure Vault (Remastered)](/Sources.aspx?ID=191) pg. 59

</row>

<row gap="medium">
<row gap="tiny"><row>**Activate**</row><actions string="Single Action" /><row>([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104))</row></row>

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This elixir bolsters your body's natural defenses and ability to resist maladies that travel through or affect blood. For 10 minutes you receive the listed resistance to [persistent bleed and persistent poison damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29), and you lower the DC for any flat checks to end persistent bleed or persistent poison damage as if you received particularly appropriate aid. 

At the GM's discretion, blood booster elixirs can also automatically [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=371) non-magical effects that specifically rely on thinning the drinker's blood, such as a [skull peeler's](/Monsters.aspx?ID=1306) anticoagulant.

This elixir bolsters your body’s natural defenses and ability to resist maladies that travel through or affect blood. For 10 minutes you receive the listed [resistance](/Rules.aspx?ID=2318) to [persistent bleed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=86) and persistent poison damage, and you lower the DC for any [flat checks](/Rules.aspx?ID=333) to end persistent bleed or persistent poison damage as if you received particularly appropriate aid. 

At the GM’s discretion, blood booster elixirs can also automatically [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=2250) non-magical effects that specifically rely on thinning the drinker’s blood, such as a [skull peeler’s](/Monsters.aspx?ID=1306) anticoagulant.

</title>

</row>

</column>

---

Used by theater troupes in combination with a fake blood pack, this bit of minor magic can simulate a dramatic and sudden wound. A _blood pack squib_ is a small unassuming stone that is keyed to a single [fake blood pack](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3528) in a process that takes 1 minute. 

**Activate—Burst Pack** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645))   **Requirements** The _blood pack squib_ must be within 20 feet of its associated fake blood pack; **Effect** You lightly squeeze the stone and the fake blood pack dramatically bursts. The creature wearing the fake blood pack gains the benefits of a punctured fake blood pack. A single creature adjacent to the creature wearing the fake blood pack must succeed at a DC 16 Reflex save or be splattered with the fake blood, becoming [dazzled](/Conditions.aspx?ID=65) until the end of their next turn. You can also activate the blood pack squib as a reaction when the fake blood pack is punctured normally.

---

This thick, blood-red elixir sharpens your senses and makes you more acutely aware of blood. You gain blood sight with the listed duration and effects. Blood sight has a range of 60 feet and allows you to detect living creatures who are taking [persistent bleed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29) damage or who have the [dying](/Conditions.aspx?ID=69) or [wounded](/Conditions.aspx?ID=99) conditions. You also detect free-standing puddles or droplets of recently spilled blood. At the GM's discretion, living creatures without blood can't be detected with your blood sight.

>
[Blood-Drinker](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3485)
</title>

<spoilers>May contain spoilers from Prey for Death</spoilers>

<traits>
<trait label="Unique" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=723" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=644" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Prey for Death](/Sources.aspx?ID=231) pg. 101

**Price** 24,000 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

</row>

<row gap="medium">
**Base Weapon** [Sawtooth Saber](/Weapons.aspx?ID=423)
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This _+3 greater striking [keen](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2843) [sawtooth saber](/Weapons.aspx?ID=423)_ has a black blade that always seems freshly smeared with blood. 

**Activate—Drink Blood** <actions string="Reaction" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32))  **Trigger** You reduce a creature to 0 Hit Points with the weapon;  **Effect** You gain a number of temporary Hit Points equal to twice the creature's level. If you're also wielding _Fleshrender_ in your other hand, you instead gain temporary Hit Points equal to three times the creature's level. These Hit Points remain for 1 minute. 

**Activate—Wall of Sabers** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) **Frequency** once per hour;  **Requirements** _Fleshrender_ is within 30 feet and isn't currently held by you; **Effect** A whirling wall of sawtooth sabers appear in the air between the paired weapons. All creatures in a line between you and _[Fleshrender](/Equipment.aspx?ID=3488)_ take 10d6 slashing damage and 4d6 [persistent bleed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29) damage (DC 38 basic Reflex save).

</title>

---

This _[+1 striking ](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2861) [shortsword](/Weapons.aspx?ID=398)_ has the design of a fanged mouth carved into the handle. Whenever the blade draws blood, it glows with a dull red energy, as if empowered by the taste of blood.

**Activate—Drink Life** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The _blood-drinker blade_ guides your hand to cut a foe and feeds you from their blood. Make a [Strike](/Actions.aspx?ID=2306) with the blade. On a hit, the attack deals an additional 1d8 [persistent bleed damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=86). You also gain 1d8 [temporary Hit Points](/Rules.aspx?ID=2321) for 1 minute.

**Price** 700 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Bulk** L

---

This is a _[+1 striking ](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2861) [wounding ](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2854) [shortsword](/Weapons.aspx?ID=398)_. You can activate to Drink Life with the blade once per hour instead of once per day. This weapon also has the Exsanguinate activation.

**Activate—Exsanguinate** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per day;  **Requirements** Your most recent action was to successfully deal bleed damage to a creature with [Drain Life](/Actions.aspx?ID=3284); **Effect** The blade’s power draws even more blood from your victim. The required creature takes 6d6 bleed damage. You gain [temporary Hit Points](/Rules.aspx?ID=2321) equal to half the bleed damage the creature takes (after applying resistances and the like). You lose any remaining temporary Hit Points after 1 minute.

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Pathfinder #148: Fires of the Haunted City](/Sources.aspx?ID=13) pg. 75

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** etched onto a clan dagger

</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

A _bloodbane_ clan dagger is especially vicious against the ancestral enemies of the clan. When you damage an appropriate type of creature with the weapon, that creature takes 1 persistent bleed damage. The type of creature depends on the clan that made the dagger, but is typically drow, duergar, giant, or orc.

 In addition, whenever you inflict persistent bleed damage with a _bloodbane_ weapon (whether from its innate ability or in some other way), the weapon leaves ragged wounds. The bleeding creature must succeed at a DC 25 Fortitude save or become sickened 1. The creature is then temporarily immune for 1 hour.

Several rings are attached to its sides at regular intervals. The top of the censer's lid is decorated with a pair of intertwining snakes. **Activate—Light Incense** ([aura](/Traits.aspx?ID=206), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104))**Cost** incense worth at least 5 gp; **Frequency** once per day; **Effect** A piping, reddish smoke pours from the censer in a 20-foot emanation. You choose whether the smoke causes the target's blood to turn extremely hot or transmutes to poison; the smoke deals your choice of fire or poison damage. Each living creature that's in the area or enters it attempts a DC 34 Fortitude saving throw, then becomes temporarily immune for 1 hour. **Critical Success** The creature is unaffected.
**Success** The creature breathes in a small amount of the poisonous smoke and takes 2d6 [persistent damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29).
**Failure** The creature gulps down a lungful of the smoke, taking 4d6 persistent damage and becoming [enfeebled 2](/Conditions.aspx?ID=13) until the persistent damage ends.
**Critical Failure** The creature inhales a large amount of the smoke, taking 6d6 persistent damage and becoming enfeebled 3 until the persistent damage ends.

---

This _[+1](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2830) [striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2829) [scythe](/Weapons.aspx?ID=394)_ is made from the cruel, blackened branches of the carnivorous scythe tree, which hungrily drink up spilled blood.

**Activate—Root in Blood** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645))   **Requirements** Your last action was a successful Strike with this weapon and your target isn’t currently taking any persistent bleed damage; **Effect** You break off a piece of the _bloodgorger scythe_ inside your enemy to feed on their blood and sprout into a new tree. The target takes 1 [persistent bleed damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=86) at the end of their turn. Each failure to stop the bleeding increases this bleed damage by 1 as a small scythe tree grows from the wound, to a maximum of 3 persistent bleed damage.

**Activate—Sapling Slash** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561))   **Requirements** A target has a piece of the _bloodgorger scythe_ broken off inside them and has failed to recover from the persistent bleed damage for 3 consecutive turns; **Effect** The sprouted scythe tree grows large enough to be commanded. It makes a melee [Strike](/Actions.aspx?ID=2306) against the target or a creature adjacent to the target, with a +18 to hit and dealing 1d10 slashing damage.

**Craft Requirements** The initial raw materials must include branches and roots from a [scythe tree](/Monsters.aspx?ID=797).

---

This strong, rich red-brown home brew has no listed ingredients, but smells of earth and is both smoky and surprisingly bitter. Although Skogg Bloodhammer insists that the drink doesn't exist, it's somewhat of an open secret among his close friends. He prefers to share this drink at backroom gatherings with these trusted friends, and usually broaches the idea of sharing with a full mug and a question: “You ever thought about being a frog?”

 After drinking the brew, you transform into an animal, gaining the effects of [_animal form_](/Spells.aspx?ID=10) except you can't Dismiss the effect, and you transform into a random animal battle form. To determine the battle form, roll 1d10 (1 = ape, 2 = bear, 3 = bull, 4 = canine, 5 = cat, 6 = deer, 7 = frog, 8 = shark, 9 = snake, 10 = reroll). Your appearance while in the battle form resembles that of animals within Emperor's Peak or from the surrounding Five Kings Mountains, such as the Five Kings dart snake or the Coldforge singing frog. More unusual battle forms like apes and sharks instead resemble a typical member of that species.

---

This wide, single-use mask is designed to be slipped over your mouth and nose and its alchemical filter activated all with one hand. Once activated, the mask sharpens odors, giving you [imprecise scent](/Rules.aspx?ID=417) with the listed range. You can't wear other masks while you're wearing a bloodhound mask. When you use [Survival](/Skills.aspx?ID=16) to [Track](/Actions.aspx?ID=66) a creature by its scent, your proficiency bonus is equal to your level even if you're untrained, and the mask grants you the listed item bonus to your Survival check. The GM sets the Survival DC based on the area's ability to hold scent rather than on visual clues, as normal for using scent.
