These thin cloth wraps, which are illegal to use in Highhelm's organized brawls, blend into the skin and add an edge to your blows. The wraps are _+1 [striking](/Equipment.aspx?ID=280) [wounding](/Equipment.aspx?ID=309) [handwraps of mighty blows](/Equipment.aspx?ID=441)_. When you invest the wraps, they gain the effects of a 3rd-level [_magic aura_](/Spells.aspx?ID=178) spell to appear non-magical and resemble simple bandages. Casual observers are unlikely to notice anything amiss with the wraps, but a creature that succeeds at a DC 25 Perception check can notice something is off about them, though they would still need to find other means to discern the magical nature of the wraps.

**Activate** <actions string="Reaction" /> envision;  **Frequency** once per minute; **Trigger** You cause a creature within reach to take bleed damage;  **Effect** You use your foe's pain to reinvigorate you. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to the value of the triggering bleed damage, up to a maximum of 10 temporary HP. These temporary Hit Points remain for 1 minute.

fields.text: Item 9 Bloodknuckles Uncommon Invested Magical Transmutation Source Highhelm pg. 86 Price 600 gp Usage worn gloves Base Weapon Fist These thin cloth wraps, which are illegal to use in Highhelm's organized brawls, blend into the skin and add an edge to your blows. The wraps are +1 striking wounding handwraps of mighty blows . When you invest the wraps, they gain the effects of a 3rd-level magic aura spell to appear non-magical and resemble simple bandages. Casual observers are unlikely to notice anything amiss with the wraps, but a creature that succeeds at a DC 25 Perception check can notice something is off about them, though they would still need to find other means to discern the magical nature of the wraps. Activate Reaction envision; Frequency once per minute; Trigger You cause a creature within reach to take bleed damage; Effect You use your foe's pain to reinvigorate you. You gain temporary Hit Points equal to the value of the triggering bleed damage, up to a maximum of 10 temporary HP. These temporary Hit Points remain for 1 minute.

---

Each _bloodline robe_ has a design that befits a particular [sorcerer](/Classes.aspx?ID=11) bloodline, depicting creatures of that bloodline or using styles common among them. You gain a +2 item bonus to each of your bloodline skills.

**Activate** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per day;  **Requirements** You're benefiting from your blood magic effect; **Effect** You're [quickened](/Conditions.aspx?ID=32) on your next turn. You can use the extra action only as part of Casting a bloodline spell.

**Activate** <actions string="Free Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You gain 1 Focus Point, which you can use only to cast a sorcerer bloodline spell. If not used by the end of your turn, this Focus Point is lost.

**Craft Requirements** You are a sorcerer of the bloodline tied to the robe.

The white leather cover of this book is splotched with rusty red bloodstains, and its pages seep red when turned, although this never stains the bearer’s hands or clothing. Anatomical drawings illustrate its pages. 

**Activate—Sanguine Expulsion** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=561), [spellshape](/Traits.aspx?ID=513)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** If your next action is to [Cast a prepared Spell](/Actions.aspx?ID=2734) that manipulates blood, such as _[_blood vendetta_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1454)_ or _[_vampiric exsanguination_](/Spells.aspx?ID=1735)_, or a spell dealing piercing or slashing damage, all targets of the triggering spell take 1d6 [persistent bleed damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=86); if the spell already causes bleed damage, the bleed damage increases by 1d6. The wounds of one affected target (chosen by you) gush uncontrollably, covering the ground with blood in a 5-foot emanation that lasts for 1 round. Creatures that begin their turn in the blood must succeed at a Reflex save against your spell DC or fall [prone](/Conditions.aspx?ID=88).

**Price** 85 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** worn garment

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

This white vest has a large crimson bloodstain that can never be removed. Imbued with the anguish of a comrade who bled to death in the creator’s arms, a _bloodstained waistcoat_ helps prevent you and your fellow soldiers from suffering the same fate. Your [flat check](/Rules.aspx?ID=333) to remove [persistent bleed damage](/Conditions.aspx?ID=86) is DC 10 instead of DC 15, which is reduced to DC 5 if another creature uses a particularly appropriate action to help.

**Activate—Staunch Bleeding** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=645)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** The stain on the _bloodstained waistcoat_ gets slightly larger as you bleed in lieu of an ally. The waistcoat ends a persistent bleed condition for one ally within 30 feet, but you gain that condition with the same parameters.

**Requirement** You have a free hand
</row>

</column>

---

This small doll has been carved from a fragment of Bloodstone. When you Activate a _bloodstone doll_ in response to another’s magic, you Interact to take it in hand and hold it up toward the triggering creature. Attempt a [counteract](/Rules.aspx?ID=2250) check against the triggering spell at the listed bonus and rank.

 If the spell would be counteracted, the _bloodstone doll_ instead influences the summoned creature. You gain control of the summoned creature and can dictate its 2 actions for that turn. The triggering creature then regains control of their summoned creature, but the summoned creature takes a –2 status penalty to attack rolls against you. Your _bloodstone doll_ shatters when the summon spell ends.

</title>

<row gap="medium">

</row>

</row>

<row gap="medium">

---

The bladed inner curve of this _+2 greater striking [keen](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2843) [wounding](/Equipment.aspx?ID=2854) [dagger](/Weapons.aspx?ID=358)_ 	has a jagged, saw-like edge, while its handle is wrapped in red leather. Carved from the mandible of a giant praying mantis, this magical weapon's blade is as sharp and serviceable as steel. 

**Activate—Sweeping Slash** <actions string="Two Actions" /> ([concentrate](/Traits.aspx?ID=32), [manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104)) **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You swing the dagger in a wide arc, causing a horizontal swipe of blood- red energy to sweep out in a 30-foot cone. All living creatures in the area take 15d6 slashing damage (DC 34 basic Reflex save), plus 1d6 [persistent bleed](/Conditions.aspx?ID=29) damage on a failed save.

</title>

<traits>
<trait label="Uncommon" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=159" />
<trait label="Consumable" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=36" />
<trait label="Magical" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=103" />
<trait label="Plant" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=125" />
<trait label="Wood" url="/Traits.aspx?ID=508" />
</traits>

<column gap="tiny">

**Source** [Rage of Elements](/Sources.aspx?ID=205) pg. 200

**Price** 68 gp

<row gap="medium">

**Usage** held in 1 hand

**Bulk** L
</row>

<row gap="medium">

 

 

 
</row>

</column>

---

The seeds of this lotus seed pod scatter with incredible ease and accuracy, quickly growing into temporary plants.

**Activate—Floating Pads** <actions string="Single Action" /> ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104))    **Effect** You scatter the _blooming lotus seed pod's_ seeds across a non-damaging liquid surface within 40 feet of you, where they form into 5 lotus pads that each float in place in a separate square within range for 1 minute. Each lotus pad has a 10- foot radius and can support 1 Large creature, 2 Medium creatures, or 4 Small creatures.

**Activate—Blooming Flower** <actions string="" /> 10 minutes ([manipulate](/Traits.aspx?ID=104))    **Effect** You plant the _blooming lotus seed pod_ in the ground and a giant lotus flower blooms in that square. Over the next 8 hours, creatures who sleep for at least 6 hours within 30 feet of the lotus flower gain the benefits of long-term rest as though they'd spent an entire day and night resting, and all creatures within the affected area are immune to the effects of the [_nightmare_](/Spells.aspx?ID=208) spell and other magical effects that affect only sleeping creatures.

<column gap="tiny">

</column>
